This is the final report for the Safe Induction of Labor in Norway Trial (SAINT). The analyses and presentation of results are in accordance with the *Statistical Analysis Plan*, version 1.0, which was signed by Trond Melbye Michelsen, Inge Christoffer Olsen, and Nina Gunnes on **June 3, 2025**. The database was locked on **June 5, 2025**.

# Initial Preparation {.hidden .unlisted .unnumbered}

We do some initial preparation.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Defining functions for reading the Excel file containing the main data in Viedoc and the Excel file containing the treatment data into R
# NOTE: The 1st function concerns the treatment data.
# NOTE: The 2nd function concerns the main data in Viedoc.
# NOTE: The 3rd function concerns the main data in Viedoc and is meant to create separate variables for the year, month, and day of the date variable specified.
read_xlsx_file1 <- function(path, sheet) {
  tmp <- xl.read.file(filename = path, header = TRUE, xl.sheet = sheet, top.left.cell = "A1", na = "", password = password_treatment) %>% 
    as_tibble() %>% 
    mutate(across(.cols = where(is.character), .fns = trimws))
  data <- tmp %>% 
    mutate(
      EXKITNO = as.character(kitno), 
      Treatment_allocated_str = case_when(
        substr(x = Treatment, start = 1, stop = 1) == "1" ~ "Peroral bicarbonate & intravenous hyoscine butylbromide", 
        substr(x = Treatment, start = 1, stop = 1) == "2" ~ "Peroral bicarbonate & intravenous placebo", 
        substr(x = Treatment, start = 1, stop = 1) == "3" ~ "Peroral placebo & intravenous hyoscine butylbromide", 
        substr(x = Treatment, start = 1, stop = 1) == "4" ~ "Peroral placebo & intravenous placebo", 
        .default = NULL
      ), 
      Treatment_allocated_num = case_when(
        substr(x = Treatment, start = 1, stop = 1) == "1" ~ 1, 
        substr(x = Treatment, start = 1, stop = 1) == "2" ~ 2, 
        substr(x = Treatment, start = 1, stop = 1) == "3" ~ 3, 
        substr(x = Treatment, start = 1, stop = 1) == "4" ~ 4, 
        .default = NULL
      )
    ) %>% 
    select(EXKITNO, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
    set_variable_labels(.labels = c("KIT number", "Allocated treatment", "Allocated treatment"))
  return(data)
}
read_xlsx_file2 <- function(path, sheet) {
  tmp1 <- xl.read.file(filename = path, header = FALSE, xl.sheet = sheet, top.left.cell = "A1", na = "", password = password_main) %>% 
    as_tibble() %>% 
    mutate(across(.cols = where(is.character), .fns = trimws)) %>% 
    slice(1) %>% 
    unlist()
  names(tmp1) <- NULL
  tmp2 <- xl.read.file(filename = path, header = FALSE, xl.sheet = sheet, top.left.cell = "A2", na = "", password = password_main) %>% 
    as_tibble() %>% 
    mutate(across(.cols = where(is.character), .fns = trimws)) %>% 
    slice(1) %>% 
    unlist()
  names(tmp2) <- NULL
  if (sheet == "Items" | sheet == "CodeLists") {
    data <- xl.read.file(filename = path, header = TRUE, xl.sheet = sheet, top.left.cell = "A2", na = "", password = password_main) %>% 
      as_tibble() %>% 
      mutate(across(.cols = where(is.character), .fns = trimws))
  } else {
    tmp3 <- Items %>% 
      filter(ID %in% tmp2)
    data <- xl.read.file(filename = path, header = TRUE, xl.sheet = sheet, top.left.cell = "A2", na = "", password = password_main) %>% 
      as_tibble() %>% 
      mutate(across(.cols = where(is.character), .fns = trimws))
    if (!identical(names(data), tmp2)) {
      data <- data %>% 
        filter(row_number() < 1)
      names(data) <- tmp2
    }
    if (dim(tmp3)[1] >= 1) {
      for (i in 1:dim(tmp3)[1]) {
        if (!is.na(tmp3$FormatName[i])) {
          data <- data %>% 
            mutate(tmp4 = as.integer(x = get(x = tmp3$ID[i])), .after = matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
            select(!matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
            rename_with(.fn = ~ paste(tmp3$ID[i]), .cols = tmp4)
        } else {
          if (tmp3$DataType[i] == "date") {
            data <- data %>% 
              mutate(tmp4 = as.Date(x = get(x = tmp3$ID[i]), format = "%Y-%m-%d"), .after = matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              select(!matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              rename_with(.fn = ~ paste(tmp3$ID[i]), .cols = tmp4)
          }
          if (tmp3$DataType[i] == "datetime") {
            data <- data %>% 
              mutate(tmp4 = as.POSIXct(x = get(x = tmp3$ID[i]), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), .after = matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              select(!matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              rename_with(.fn = ~ paste(tmp3$ID[i]), .cols = tmp4)
          }
          if (tmp3$DataType[i] == "double") {
            data <- data %>% 
              mutate(tmp4 = as.double(x = get(x = tmp3$ID[i])), .after = matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              select(!matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              rename_with(.fn = ~ paste(tmp3$ID[i]), .cols = tmp4)
          }
          if (tmp3$DataType[i] == "integer") {
            data <- data %>% 
              mutate(tmp4 = as.integer(x = get(x = tmp3$ID[i])), .after = matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              select(!matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              rename_with(.fn = ~ paste(tmp3$ID[i]), .cols = tmp4)
          }
          if (tmp3$DataType[i] == "string") {
            data <- data %>% 
              mutate(tmp4 = as.character(x = get(x = tmp3$ID[i])), .after = matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              select(!matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              rename_with(.fn = ~ paste(tmp3$ID[i]), .cols = tmp4)
          }
          if (tmp3$DataType[i] == "text") {
            data <- data %>% 
              mutate(tmp4 = as.character(x = get(x = tmp3$ID[i])), .after = matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              select(!matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              rename_with(.fn = ~ paste(tmp3$ID[i]), .cols = tmp4)
          }
          if (tmp3$DataType[i] == "time") {
            data <- data %>% 
              mutate(tmp4 = as.character(x = get(x = tmp3$ID[i])), .after = matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              select(!matches(match = paste("^", tmp3$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
              rename_with(.fn = ~ paste(tmp3$ID[i]), .cols = tmp4)
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  data <- data %>% 
    set_variable_labels(.labels = tmp1)
  return(data)
}
read_xlsx_file3 <- function(path, sheet, var) {
  tmp <- ensym(var)
  data <- xl.read.file(filename = path, header = TRUE, xl.sheet = sheet, top.left.cell = "A2", na = "", password = password_main) %>% 
    as_tibble() %>% 
    mutate(across(.cols = where(is.character), .fns = trimws)) %>% 
    mutate(
      SubjectId = as.character(x = SubjectId), 
      EventSeq = as.character(x = EventSeq), 
      EventId = as.character(x = EventId), 
      EventDate = as.Date(x = EventDate, format = "%Y-%m-%d"), 
      ActivityId = as.character(x = ActivityId), 
      FormSeq = as.character(x = FormSeq), 
      SubjectFormSeq = as.integer(x = SubjectFormSeq), 
      OriginSubjectFormSeq = as.integer(x = OriginSubjectFormSeq), 
      SourceSubjectFormSeq = as.integer(x = SourceSubjectFormSeq), 
      date = as.character(x = !!tmp), 
      year = as.numeric(x = if_else(condition = substr(x = date, start = 1, stop = 4) == "NK", true = NA, false = substr(x = date, start = 1, stop = 4), missing = NULL)), 
      month = as.numeric(x = if_else(condition = substr(x = date, start = 6, stop = 7) == "NK", true = NA, false = substr(x = date, start = 6, stop = 7), missing = NULL)), 
      day = as.numeric(x = if_else(condition = substr(x = date, start = 9, stop = 10) == "NK", true = NA, false = substr(x = date, start = 9, stop = 10), missing = NULL))
    ) %>% 
    select(SubjectId, EventSeq, EventId, EventDate, ActivityId, FormSeq, SubjectFormSeq, OriginSubjectFormSeq, SourceSubjectFormSeq, date, year, month, day)
  return(data)
}

# Defining a function for adding columns for variables with value labels and factors
add_value_labels_factors <- function(data) {
  tmp1 <- Items %>% 
    filter(ID %in% names(data) & !is.na(FormatName))
  if (dim(tmp1)[1] >= 1) {
    for (i in 1:dim(tmp1)[1]) {
      data <- data %>% 
        mutate(
          tmp2 = set_value_labels(.data = get(x = tmp1$ID[i]), .labels = get(x = tmp1$FormatName[i])), 
          tmp3 = factor(x = get(x = tmp1$ID[i]), levels = get(x = tmp1$FormatName[i]), labels = labels(get(x = tmp1$FormatName[i])))
        ) %>% 
        relocate(tmp2, tmp3, .after = matches(match = paste("^", tmp1$ID[i], "$", sep = ""))) %>% 
        rename_with(.fn = ~ paste(tmp1$ID[i], c("labeled", "factor"), sep = "_"), .cols = c(tmp2, tmp3))
      tmp4 <- data %>% 
        group_by(!!sym(tmp1$ID[i]), !!sym(paste(tmp1$ID[i], "labeled", sep = "_")), !!sym(paste(tmp1$ID[i], "factor", sep = "_"))) %>% 
        count() %>% 
        ungroup()
      # print(tmp4)
    }
  }
  return(data)
}

# Defining a function for adding columns for the variables for the allocated treatment
add_treatment <- function(data) {
  tmp <- read_xlsx_file2(path = path_main, sheet = "EX") %>% 
    filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01" & !is.na(EXKITNO)) %>% 
    select(SubjectId, EXKITNO) %>% 
    inner_join(y = treatment, by = "EXKITNO") %>% 
    select(SubjectId, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num)
  data <- data %>% 
    left_join(y = tmp, by = "SubjectId")
  return(data)
}

# Defining a function for restricting to the first 2000 randomized subjects with signed informed consent
# NOTE: An observed date of informed consent confirms that an informed consent form has been signed by the study subject.
restrict <- function(data) {
  tmp1 <- read_xlsx_file(path = path_main, sheet = "DM") %>% 
    filter(!is.na(DMICDAT))
  tmp2 <- read_xlsx_file(path = path_main, sheet = "EX") %>% 
    filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01" & !is.na(EXKITNO) & !is.na(EXALDAT)) %>% 
    semi_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
    slice_min(order_by = tibble(EXALDAT, EXALTIM), n = 2000, with_ties = FALSE)
  data <- data %>% 
    semi_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId")
  return(data)
}

# Defining a function for not calculating any summary statistics
calculate_no_summary_statistics <- function(data, group, var) {
  tmp <- ensym(group)
  result <- data %>% 
    group_by(!!tmp) %>% 
    summarize(.groups = "drop") %>% 
    mutate(txt = "") %>% 
    arrange(!!tmp, .locale = "no") %>% 
    deframe()
  return(result)
}

# Defining functions for calculating summary statistics of categorical variables
calculate_summary_statistics_categorical1 <- function(data, group, var, digits, level) {
  tmp1 <- ensym(group)
  tmp2 <- ensym(var)
  tmp3 <- paste("[%d] %d (%.", digits, "f%%)", sep = "")
  result <- data %>% 
    mutate(tmp3 = if_else(condition = is.na(as.character(!!tmp2)), true = "", false = as.character(!!tmp2), missing = NULL)) %>% 
    group_by(SubjectId, !!tmp1) %>% 
    summarize(
      tmp4 = sum(tmp3 == level, na.rm = TRUE), 
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    mutate(tmp5 = if_else(condition = tmp4 == 0, true = 0, false = 1, missing = NULL)) %>% 
    group_by(!!tmp1, tmp5) %>% 
    summarize(
      N = sum(tmp4, na.rm = TRUE), 
      n = n(), 
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    complete(!!tmp1, tmp5, fill = list(N = 0, n = 0)) %>% 
    group_by(!!tmp1) %>% 
    mutate(
      n_tot = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE), 
      pct = round(x = n / n_tot * 100, digits = digits), 
      # txt = paste("[", N, "] ", n, " (", pct, "%)", sep = "")
      txt = sprintf(fmt = tmp3, N, n, n / n_tot * 100)
    ) %>% 
    filter(tmp5 == 1) %>% 
    select(!!tmp1, txt) %>% 
    arrange(!!tmp1, .locale = "no") %>% 
    deframe()
  return(result)
}
calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2 <- function(data, group, var, digits, level) {

      # txt = paste(n, " (", pct, "%)", sep = "")
      txt = sprintf(fmt = tmp3, n, n / n_tot * 100)
    ) %>%

}

# Defining functions for calculating summary statistics of continuous variables
calculate_summary_statistics_continuous1 <- function(data, group, var, digits) {
  tmp1 <- ensym(group)
  tmp2 <- ensym(var)
  tmp3 <- paste("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f)", sep = "")
  result <- data %>% 
    mutate(tmp3 = as.numeric(!!tmp2)) %>% 
    group_by(!!tmp1) %>% 
    summarize(
      mean = mean(x = tmp3, na.rm = TRUE), 
      sd = sd(x = tmp3, na.rm = TRUE), 
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    # mutate_at(.vars = vars(mean, sd), .funs = ~ round(x = ., digits = digits)) %>% 
    # mutate(txt = paste(mean, " (", sd, ")", sep = "")) %>% 
    mutate(txt = sprintf(fmt = tmp3, mean, sd)) %>% 
    select(!!tmp1, txt) %>% 
    arrange(!!tmp1, .locale = "no") %>% 
    deframe()
  return(result)
}

  # tmp3 <- paste("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f to %.", digits, "f)", sep = "")

# Defining a function for calculating the median survival time for time-to-event variables
# NOTE: The 1st function is based on R code. Choose between finding the time corresponding to the cumulative incidence closest to 0.5 or finding the time corresponding to the minimum cumulative incidence equal to or greater than 0.5 by commenting out one of the lines below.
# NOTE: The 2nd function is based on Stata code.
calculate_summary_statistics_time_to_event1 <- function(data, group, var, digits, level) {
  tmp1 <- var[[1]]
  tmp2 <- var[[2]]
  # tmp3 <- ensym(tmp1)
  # tmp4 <- ensym(tmp2)
  tmp3 <- sym(tmp1)
  tmp4 <- sym(tmp2)
  tmp5 <- ensym(group)
  tmp6 <- data %>% 
    mutate(
      status = as.integer(x = if_else(condition = !!tmp3 == 0, true = 0, false = if_else(condition = !!tmp3 == level, true = 1, false = 2, missing = NULL), missing = NULL)), 
      time = !!tmp4, 
      group = !!tmp5
    )
  tmp7 <- cuminc(ftime = tmp6$time, fstatus = tmp6$status, group = tmp6$group, cencode = 0)
  result <- bind_cols(tmp1 = names(tmp7)[1:(length(tmp7) - 1)], tmp2 = numeric(length = length(tmp7) - 1))
  for (i in 1:(length(tmp7) - 1)) {
    tmp8 <- tmp7[[i]]$time
    tmp9 <- tmp7[[i]]$est
    # result[i, 2] <- round(x = tmp8[which.min(x = abs(x = tmp9 - 0.5))], digits = digits)
    result[i, 2] <- round(x = tmp8[which.max(x = tmp9 >= 0.5)], digits = digits)
  }
  result <- as_tibble(result) %>% 
    filter(substr(x = tmp1, start = nchar(x = tmp1, type = "chars"), stop = nchar(x = tmp1, type = "chars")) == "1") %>% 
    mutate(
      tmp1 = substr(x = tmp1, start = 1, stop = nchar(x = tmp1, type = "chars") - 2), 
      tmp2 = as.character(x = tmp2)
    ) %>% 
    arrange(tmp1, .locale = "no") %>% 
    deframe()
  return(result)
}
calculate_summary_statistics_time_to_event2 <- function(data, group, var, digits) {
  tmp1 <- var[[1]]
  tmp2 <- var[[2]]
  # tmp3 <- ensym(tmp1)
  # tmp4 <- ensym(tmp2)
  tmp3 <- sym(tmp1)
  tmp4 <- sym(tmp2)
  tmp5 <- ensym(group)
  result <- data %>% 
    mutate(
      tmp6 = as.numeric(!!tmp3), 
      tmp7 = as.numeric(!!tmp4)
    ) %>% 
    filter(tmp6 >= 0.5) %>% 
    group_by(!!tmp5) %>% 
    summarize(
      min = min(tmp7, na.rm = TRUE), 
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    mutate_at(.vars = vars(min), .funs = ~ round(x = ., digits = digits)) %>% 
    mutate(txt = paste(min, sep = "")) %>% 
    select(!!tmp5, txt) %>% 
    arrange(!!tmp5, .locale = "no") %>% 
    deframe()
  return(result)
}

# Defining a function for executing a function
execute_summary_statistics <- function(fun, data, group, var, ...) {
  exec(.fn = fun, data, group, var, !!!(...))
}

# Defining a function for creating a table of summary statistics
create_table_summary_statistics <- function(table, data, group) {
  tmp1 <- ensym(group)
  tmp2 <- data %>% 
    group_by(SubjectId, !!tmp1) %>% 
    summarize(.groups = "drop") %>% 
    group_by(!!tmp1) %>% 
    summarize(
      n = n(), 
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    mutate(txt = paste(!!tmp1, " (n = ", n, ")", sep = "")) %>% 
    select(txt) %>% 
    deframe() %>% 
    sort() %>% 
    c("Characteristic", .)
  table <- table %>% 
    mutate(
      data = list(data), 
      group = group
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      tmp5 = pmap(.l = list(fun, data, group, var, par), .f = execute_summary_statistics), 
      tmp6 = map(.x = tmp5, .f = names)
    ) %>% 
    unnest(cols = c(tmp5, tmp6)) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = tmp6, names_sort = TRUE, values_from = tmp5) %>% 
    select(-c(var, fun, par, data, group))
  names(table) <- tmp2
  return(table)
}

# Defining functions for creating a table of summary statistics by the preferred term according to the Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities
create_table_summary_statistics_MedDRA1 <- function(data, group, filter, digits) {
  tmp1 <- ensym(group)
  tmp2 <- ensym(filter)
  table <- data %>% 
    bind_rows(data, .id = "identifier") %>% 
    mutate(pt_name = if_else(condition = identifier == 2, true = "#", false = pt_name)) %>% 
    group_by(!!tmp1) %>% 
    mutate(n_tot = n_distinct(SubjectId, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
    filter(!!tmp2 == 1) %>% 
    group_by(SubjectId, !!tmp1, soc_name, pt_name, n_tot) %>% 
    summarize(
      tmp3 = n(), 
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    group_by(!!tmp1, soc_name, pt_name, n_tot) %>% 
    summarize(
      N = sum(tmp3), 
      n = n(), 
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      group = paste(!!tmp1, " (n = ", n_tot, ")", sep = ""), 
      pct = round(x = n / n_tot * 100, digits = digits), 
      txt = paste("[", N,"] ", n, " (", pct, "%)", sep = "")
    ) %>% 
    select(soc_name, pt_name, group, txt) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = group, names_sort = TRUE, values_from = txt) %>% 
    mutate_at(.vars = vars(-c(soc_name, pt_name)), .funs = ~ if_else(condition = is.na(.), true = "[0] 0 (0%)", false = .)) %>% 
    arrange(soc_name, pt_name) %>% 
    mutate(tmp4 = soc_name) %>% 
    group_by(tmp4) %>% 
    mutate(soc_name = if_else(condition = row_number() == 1, true = soc_name, false = "")) %>% 
    mutate_at(.vars = "pt_name", .funs = ~ if_else(condition = . == "#", true = "Total", false = .)) %>% 
    rename(
      `System organ class` = soc_name, 
      `Preferred term` = pt_name
    ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    select(-tmp4)
  return(table)
}

# Defining a function for creating a plot of the cumulative sum of the number of instances (i.e., subjects or events) as a function of calendar date
create_plot_cumsum_date <- function(data, filter, group, var, direction, ylab, title, caption) {
  tmp1 <- ensym(filter)
  tmp2 <- ensym(group)
  tmp3 <- ensym(var)
  tmp4 <- data %>% 
    filter(!!tmp1 == 1) %>% 
    group_by(!!tmp2, !!tmp3) %>% 
    summarize(
      tmp5 = n(), 
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    group_by(!!tmp2) %>% 
    mutate(tmp6 = cumsum(tmp5)) %>% 
    ungroup()
  tmp5 <- tmp4 %>% select(!!tmp2) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% length() %>% sqrt() %>% ceiling()
  plot <- ggplot(data = tmp4, mapping = aes(x = !!tmp3, y = tmp6, color = !!tmp2)) + 
    # geom_point() + 
    geom_line() + 
    facet_wrap(
      facets = vars(!!tmp2), 
      ncol = tmp5, 
      scales = "fixed", 
      dir = direction
    ) + 
    labs(
      x = "Calendar date", 
      y = ylab, 
      title = title, 
      caption = caption
    ) + 
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"), 
      legend.position = "none", 
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
  return(plot)
}

# Defining a function for finding the highest mode of a variable, i.e., the highest value of those with the highest frequency
# NOTE: The 1st function is based on Copilot and information on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/2547402/how-to-find-the-statistical-mode.
# NOTE: The 2nd function is more "home-made".
find_highest_mode1 <- function(var) {
  tmp1 <- unique(x = var)
  tmp2 <- tabulate(bin = match(x = var, table = tmp1))
  highest_mode <- max(tmp1[tmp2 == max(tmp2)], na.rm = TRUE)
  return(highest_mode)
}
find_highest_mode2 <- function(var) {
  tmp1 <- table(var, useNA = "no")
  tmp2 <- as.numeric(names(tmp1))
  highest_mode <- max(tmp2[tmp1 == max(tmp1, na.rm = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE)
  return(highest_mode)
}

# Data Loading

```{r, include = FALSE}
# Keeping the command for hiding a section from the final report until it becomes relevant
# {.hidden .unlisted .unnumbered}
```

We load 1) the treatment data contained in the Excel file `r file_treatment` and 2) the main data in Viedoc contained in the Excel file `r file_main`.

## Treatment Data

We load the treatment data.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Reading the data into R
Sys.sleep(time = 1)
treatment <- read_xlsx_file1(path = path_treatment, sheet = "Sheet 1")
dim(treatment)
table(treatment$Treatment_allocated_str, treatment$Treatment_allocated_num, useNA = "ifany")
```

The loaded dataset comprises `r dim(treatment)[1]` rows and `r dim(treatment)[2]` columns.

## Main Data

The main data were exported from Viedoc on `r month(x = as.Date(x = substr(x = file_main, start = 5, stop = 12), format = "%Y%m%d"), label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)` `r day(x = as.Date(x = substr(x = file_main, start = 5, stop = 12), format = "%Y%m%d"))`, `r year(x = as.Date(x = substr(x = file_main, start = 5, stop = 12), format = "%Y%m%d"))`. We used the default set-up for data export in Viedoc in addition to checking off *Medical coding* and *Subject status* in the field that indicates the type of data to be exported.

The Excel file containing the main data comprises the following `r length(sheets_main) - 1` sheets, some of which correspond to the different forms in Viedoc:

1. DM: Informed Consent/Demographics
2. IE: Inclusion/Exclusion Evaluation
3. IN: Induction
4. PE: Maternal Physical Examination
5. LB: Laboratory Tests
6. VS: Vital Signs
7. SQ: Safety Questions
8. GS: Genetic Sample
9. EX: Study Intervention
10. DE: Delivery Information
11. NS: Neonatal Status
12. ICC: Informed Consent Child
13. MCD: Maternal Complications and Duration of Stay
14. CEQ: The Childbirth Experience Questionnaire
15. EOS: End of Study
16. EUB: Emergency Unblinding
17. AE: Adverse Event
18. CM: Concomitant Medication
19. MH: Medical History
20. DV: Protocol Deviation
21. CO: Comments
22. Items
23. CodeLists
24. ATC without DDD
25. MedDRA
26. Calculated subject status

### Items

The *Items* form includes all items in the main forms.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Reading the data into R
Sys.sleep(time = 1)
Items <- read_xlsx_file2(path = path_main, sheet = "Items")
dim(Items)
```

The loaded dataset comprises `r dim(Items)[1]` rows and `r dim(Items)[2]` columns.

### Code Lists

The *CodeLists* form includes all code lists in the main forms.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Reading the data into R
Sys.sleep(time = 1)
CodeLists <- read_xlsx_file2(path = path_main, sheet = "CodeLists")
dim(CodeLists)

# Creating vectors of value labels
tmp1 <- unique(CodeLists$FormatName)
for (i in 1:length(tmp1)) {
  tmp2 <- CodeLists %>% filter(FormatName == tmp1[i])
  tmp3 <- NULL
  for (j in 1:dim(tmp2)[1]) {
    tmp3 <- c(tmp3, eval(parse(text = paste("c(\"", tmp2$CodeText[j], "\" = ",  as.numeric(tmp2$CodeValue[j]), ")", sep = ""))))
  }
  assign(x = tmp1[i], value = tmp3)
}
rm(i, j, list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

The loaded dataset comprises `r dim(CodeLists)[1]` rows and `r dim(CodeLists)[2]` columns.

### Informed Consent and Demographics

The *DM* form includes data on informed consent and demographics and has *7* items.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Reading the data into R and adding columns for variables with value labels, factors, and the variable for the allocated treatment
Sys.sleep(time = 1)
DM <- read_xlsx_file2(path = path_main, sheet = "DM") %>% add_value_labels_factors() %>% add_treatment()
dim(DM)

# Displaying the frequency of each combination of IDs and names of events and activities and various form sequences
DM %>% group_by(EventId, EventName, ActivityId, ActivityName) %>% count()

# Identifying unique identifiers
DM %>% isid(vars = c("SubjectId"))
DM %>% isid(vars = c("SubjectId", "EventId"))
DM %>% isid(vars = c("SubjectId", "EventId", "EventSeq"))
DM %>% isid(vars = c("SubjectId", "EventId", "EventSeq", "ActivityId"))
DM %>% isid(vars = c("SubjectId", "EventId", "EventSeq", "ActivityId", "FormSeq"))
```

After adding columns for one variable with value labels and one factor for each categorical variable in addition to a variable for the allocated treatment, the loaded dataset comprises `r dim(DM)[1]` rows and `r dim(DM)[2]` columns.

# Data Preparation

We do some data preparation.

## Main Data

We consider the main data.

### Informed Consent and Demographics

We create a categorical variable for age.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding a column for the categorical variable for age
DM <- DM %>% 
  mutate(
    DMAGE_cat = case_when(
      DMAGE < 25               ~ 1, 
      DMAGE >= 25 & DMAGE < 30 ~ 2, 
      DMAGE >= 30 & DMAGE < 35 ~ 3, 
      DMAGE >= 35 & DMAGE < 40 ~ 4, 
      DMAGE >= 40              ~ 5, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    DMAGE_cat_factor = factor(x = DMAGE_cat, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), labels = c("< 25 years", "25-29 years", "30-34 years", "35-39 years", ">= 40 years")), 
    .after = DMAGE
  )
var_label(DM$DMAGE_cat) <- "Categorized age"
var_label(DM$DMAGE_cat_factor) <- "Categorized age, factor"
dim(DM)
```

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Producing some summary statistics
summary(DM$DMAGE[which(DM$DMAGE_cat == 1)])
summary(DM$DMAGE[which(DM$DMAGE_cat == 2)])
summary(DM$DMAGE[which(DM$DMAGE_cat == 3)])
summary(DM$DMAGE[which(DM$DMAGE_cat == 4)])
summary(DM$DMAGE[which(DM$DMAGE_cat == 5)])
summary(DM$DMAGE[which(is.na(DM$DMAGE_cat))])
table(DM$DMAGE_cat, DM$DMAGE_cat_factor, useNA = "ifany")
```

We create a categorical variable for health region.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding a column for the variable for health region
DM <- DM %>% 
  mutate(
    Health_region = case_when(
      SiteCode == "01" | SiteCode == "02" | SiteCode == "03" | SiteCode == "04" | SiteCode == "05" | SiteCode == "06" | SiteCode == "11" ~ 1, 
      SiteCode == "07" | SiteCode == "08"                                                                                                ~ 2, 
      SiteCode == "09"                                                                                                                   ~ 3, 
      SiteCode == "10"                                                                                                                   ~ 4, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    Health_region_factor = factor(x = Health_region, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("South-Eastern Norway Regional Health Authority", "Western Norway Regional Health Authority", "Central Norway Regional Health Authority", "Northern Norway Regional Health Authority"))
  )
var_label(DM$Health_region) <- "Health region"
var_label(DM$Health_region_factor) <- "Health region, factor"
dim(DM)
```

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Producing some summary statistics
table(DM$SiteName, DM$Health_region, useNA = "ifany")
table(DM$SiteName, DM$Health_region_factor, useNA = "ifany")
table(DM$SiteCode, DM$Health_region, useNA = "ifany")
table(DM$SiteCode, DM$Health_region_factor, useNA = "ifany")
table(DM$Health_region, DM$Health_region_factor, useNA = "ifany")
```

### Inclusion and Exclusion Evaluation

We create dichotomous variables for the inclusion and exclusion criteria.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for indicator variables for inclusion and exclusion criteria
tmp1 <- IN %>% 
  select(SubjectId, ININDCD, INOTHM) %>% 
  mutate(
    tmp1 = if_else(condition = ININDCD == 3 | ININDCD == 9, true = 1, false = 0, missing = 0), 
    tmp2 = if_else(condition = grepl(pattern = "cholestase", x = INOTHM, ignore.case = TRUE) | grepl(pattern = "cholestasia", x = INOTHM, ignore.case = TRUE) | grepl(pattern = "cholestasis", x = INOTHM, ignore.case = TRUE) | grepl(pattern = "hepatose", x = INOTHM, ignore.case = TRUE) | grepl(pattern = "hepatosis", x = INOTHM, ignore.case = TRUE) | grepl(pattern = "ICP", x = INOTHM, ignore.case = TRUE) | grepl(pattern = "IHC", x = INOTHM, ignore.case = TRUE) | grepl(pattern = "kolestase", x = INOTHM, ignore.case = TRUE), true = 1, false = 0, missing = 0)
  )
tmp2 <- MedDRA %>% 
  filter(EventId == "MH" & ActivityId == "MH" & FormId == "MH" & ItemId == "MHTERM") %>% 
  rename(MHTERM = Term) %>% 
  select(SubjectId, EventSeq, EventId, EventDate, ActivityId, FormSeq, SubjectFormSeq, OriginSubjectFormSeq, SourceSubjectFormSeq, MHTERM, CodeSeqNumber, soc_name, pt_name) %>% 
  left_join(x = MH, by = c("SubjectId", "EventSeq", "EventId", "EventDate", "ActivityId", "FormSeq", "SubjectFormSeq", "OriginSubjectFormSeq", "SourceSubjectFormSeq", "MHTERM")) %>% 
  relocate(CodeSeqNumber, soc_name, pt_name, .after = MHTERM) %>% 
  mutate(
    tmp3 = if_else(condition = MHPRCCD == 8 | MHPRCCD == 9 | MHPRCCD == 10 | MHPRCCD == 13, true = 1, false = 0, missing = 0), 
    tmp4 = if_else(condition = MHCATCD == 2 & pt_name == "Cholestasis of pregnancy", true = 1, false = 0, missing = 0), 
    tmp5 = if_else(condition = MHCATCD == 1 & pt_name == "Myasthenia gravis", true = 1, false = 0, missing = 0)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(SubjectId) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp3 = if_else(condition = sum(tmp3, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, true = 1, false = 0, missing = NULL), 
    tmp4 = if_else(condition = sum(tmp4, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, true = 1, false = 0, missing = NULL), 
    tmp5 = if_else(condition = sum(tmp5, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, true = 1, false = 0, missing = NULL), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp3 <- DV %>% 
  filter(DVCATCD == 1 & DVPLCLASCD == 1) %>% 
  group_by(SubjectId) %>% 
  summarize(.groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(tmp6 = 1)
IE <- IE %>% 
  left_join(y = DM %>% select(SubjectId, DMAGE), by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = LB %>% select(SubjectId, LBCRERES, LBSODRES, LBPOTRES, LBALTRES), by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1 %>% select(SubjectId, tmp1, tmp2), by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2 %>% select(SubjectId, tmp3, tmp4, tmp5), by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3 %>% select(SubjectId, tmp6), by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  mutate(
    tmp1 = if_else(condition = is.na(tmp1), true = 0, false = tmp1, missing = NULL), 
    tmp2 = if_else(condition = is.na(tmp2), true = 0, false = tmp2, missing = NULL), 
    tmp3 = if_else(condition = is.na(tmp3), true = 0, false = tmp3, missing = NULL), 
    tmp4 = if_else(condition = is.na(tmp4), true = 0, false = tmp4, missing = NULL), 
    tmp5 = if_else(condition = is.na(tmp5), true = 0, false = tmp5, missing = NULL), 
    tmp6 = if_else(condition = is.na(tmp6), true = 0, false = tmp6, missing = NULL)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(IEIN1_edited = if_else(condition = DMAGE >= 18 & DMAGE <= 50, true = "Yes", false = "No", missing = NULL), .after = IEIN1) %>% 
  mutate(IEIN2_edited = IEIN2, .after = IEIN2) %>% 
  mutate(IEIN3_edited = IEIN3, .after = IEIN3) %>% 
  mutate(IEIN4_edited = IEIN4, .after = IEIN4) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX1_edited = IEEX1, .after = IEEX1) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX2_edited = IEEX2, .after = IEEX2) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX3_edited = IEEX3, .after = IEEX3) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX4_edited = IEEX4, .after = IEEX4) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX5_edited = if_else(condition = LBSODRES < 125 | LBPOTRES < 2.5, true = "Yes", false = "No", missing = NULL), .after = IEEX5) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX6_edited = if_else(condition = LBCRERES > 110, true = "Yes", false = "No", missing = NULL), .after = IEEX6) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX7_edited = if_else(condition = LBALTRES > 100 & tmp1 == 0 & tmp2 == 0 & tmp3 == 0 & tmp4 == 0, true = "Yes", false = "No", missing = NULL), .after = IEEX7) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX8_edited = if_else(condition = tmp5 == 1, true = "Yes", false = "No", missing = NULL), .after = IEEX8) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX9_edited = IEEX9, .after = IEEX9) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX10_edited = IEEX10, .after = IEEX10) %>% 
  mutate(IEYN_edited = if_else(condition = IEIN1_edited == "Yes" & IEIN2_edited == "Yes" & IEIN3_edited == "Yes" & IEIN4_edited == "Yes" & IEEX1_edited == "No" & IEEX2_edited == "No" & IEEX3_edited == "No" & IEEX4_edited == "No" & (IEEX5_edited == "No" | is.na(IEEX5_edited)) & (IEEX6_edited == "No" | is.na(IEEX6_edited)) & (IEEX7_edited == "No" | is.na(IEEX7_edited)) & IEEX8_edited == "No" & IEEX9_edited == "No" & IEEX10_edited == "No" & tmp6 == 0, true = "Yes", false = "No", missing = "No"), .after = IEYN) %>% 
  mutate(IEIN1CD_edited = if_else(condition = DMAGE >= 18 & DMAGE <= 50, true = 1, false = 0, missing = NULL), .after = IEIN1CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEIN2CD_edited = IEIN2CD, .after = IEIN2CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEIN3CD_edited = IEIN3CD, .after = IEIN3CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEIN4CD_edited = IEIN4CD, .after = IEIN4CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX1CD_edited = IEEX1CD, .after = IEEX1CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX2CD_edited = IEEX2CD, .after = IEEX2CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX3CD_edited = IEEX3CD, .after = IEEX3CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX4CD_edited = IEEX4CD, .after = IEEX4CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX5CD_edited = if_else(condition = LBSODRES < 125 | LBPOTRES < 2.5, true = 1, false = 0, missing = NULL), .after = IEEX5CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX6CD_edited = if_else(condition = LBCRERES > 110, true = 1, false = 0, missing = NULL), .after = IEEX6CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX7CD_edited = if_else(condition = LBALTRES > 100 & tmp1 == 0 & tmp2 == 0 & tmp3 == 0 & tmp4 == 0, true = 1, false = 0, missing = NULL), .after = IEEX7CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX8CD_edited = if_else(condition = tmp5 == 1, true = 1, false = 0, missing = NULL), .after = IEEX8CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX9CD_edited = IEEX9CD, .after = IEEX9CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEEX10CD_edited = IEEX10CD, .after = IEEX10CD) %>% 
  mutate(IEYNCD_edited = if_else(condition = IEIN1CD_edited == 1 & IEIN2CD_edited == 1 & IEIN3CD_edited == 1 & IEIN4CD_edited == 1 & IEEX1CD_edited == 0 & IEEX2CD_edited == 0 & IEEX3CD_edited == 0 & IEEX4CD_edited == 0 & (IEEX5CD_edited == 0 | is.na(IEEX5CD_edited)) & (IEEX6CD_edited == 0 | is.na(IEEX6CD_edited)) & (IEEX7CD_edited == 0 | is.na(IEEX7CD_edited)) & IEEX8CD_edited == 0 & IEEX9CD_edited == 0 & IEEX10CD_edited == 0 & tmp6 == 0, true = 1, false = 0, missing = 0), .after = IEYNCD)
dim(IE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

### Induction

We create a categorical variable for main indication for induction.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding a column for the categorical variable for main indication for induction
IN <- IN %>% 
  mutate(
    ININDCD_cat = case_when(
      ININDCD == 1                                                                                                ~ 1, 
      ININDCD == 2                                                                                                ~ 2, 
      ININDCD == 3 | ININDCD == 4                                                                                 ~ 3, 
      ININDCD == 7                                                                                                ~ 4, 
      ININDCD == 5                                                                                                ~ 5, 
      ININDCD == 6 | ININDCD == 11                                                                                ~ 6, 
      ININDCD == 8 | ININDCD == 9 | ININDCD == 10 | ININDCD == 12 | ININDCD == 13 | ININDCD == 14 | ININDCD == 15 ~ 7, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    ININDCD_cat_factor = factor(x = ININDCD_cat, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7), labels = c("Post-term pregnancy", "Prelabor rupture of membranes", "Preeclampsia or hypertension", "Maternal diabetes", "Intrauterine growth restriction", "Polyhydramnios or oligohydramnios", "Other")), 
    .after = ININDCD_factor
  )
var_label(IN$ININDCD_cat) <- "Categorized main indication for induction"
var_label(IN$ININDCD_cat_factor) <- "Categorized main indication for induction, factor"
dim(IN)
```

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Producing some summary statistics
table(IN$ININD, IN$ININDCD_cat_factor, useNA = "ifany")
table(IN$ININDCD, IN$ININDCD_cat, useNA = "ifany")
table(IN$ININDCD_cat, IN$ININDCD_cat_factor, useNA = "ifany")
```

We create a date-time variable for start of induction and a continuous variable for gestational age at the start of induction (days).

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for the gestational age at start of induction
tmp <- DE %>% select(SubjectId, DEDAT, DETIM, DEWEEK, DEDAYS)
IN <- IN %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  mutate(
    tmp1 = as.POSIXct(x = paste(DEDAT, " ", DETIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
    tmp2 = as.POSIXct(x = paste(INFOLDAT, " ", INFOLTIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
    tmp3 = as.POSIXct(x = paste(INMISDAT, " ", INMISTIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
    tmp4 = as.POSIXct(x = paste(INDINDAT, " ", INDINTIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
    tmp5 = as.POSIXct(x = paste(INAMNDAT, " ", INAMNTIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
    tmp6 = as.POSIXct(x = paste(INOXYDAT, " ", INOXYTIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
  ) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    date_time_start_induction = min(tmp2, tmp3, tmp4, tmp5, tmp6, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .after = INOXYTIM
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    tmp7 = difftime(time1 = as.Date(x = tmp1, tz = ""), time2 = as.Date(x = date_time_start_induction, tz = ""), units = "days"), 
    gestational_age_start_induction = DEWEEK * 7 + DEDAYS - tmp7, 
    .after = date_time_start_induction
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(tmp1, tmp2, tmp3, tmp4, tmp5, tmp6, tmp7))
var_label(IN$date_time_start_induction) <- "Date and time of start of induction"
var_label(IN$gestational_age_start_induction) <- "Gestational age at start of induction (days)"
dim(IN)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Producing some summary statistics
summary(IN$date_time_start_induction)
summary(IN$gestational_age_start_induction)
```

### Maternal Physical Examination

We create a categorical variable for body mass index.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding a column for the categorical variable for body mass index
PE <- PE %>% 
  mutate(
    PEBMI_cat = case_when(
      PEBMI < 18.5               ~ 1, 
      PEBMI >= 18.5 & PEBMI < 25 ~ 2, 
      PEBMI >= 25 & PEBMI < 30   ~ 3, 
      PEBMI >= 30                ~ 4, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    PEBMI_cat_factor = factor(x = PEBMI_cat, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("< 18.5 kg/m2", "18.5-24.9 kg/m2", "25.0-29.9 kg/m2", ">= 30.0 kg/m2")), 
    .after = PEBMI
  )
var_label(PE$PEBMI_cat) <- "Categorized BMI"
var_label(PE$PEBMI_cat_factor) <- "Categorized BMI, factor"
dim(PE)
```

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Producing some summary statistics
summary(PE$PEBMI[which(PE$PEBMI_cat == 1)])
summary(PE$PEBMI[which(PE$PEBMI_cat == 2)])
summary(PE$PEBMI[which(PE$PEBMI_cat == 3)])
summary(PE$PEBMI[which(PE$PEBMI_cat == 4)])
summary(PE$PEBMI[which(is.na(PE$PEBMI_cat))])
table(PE$PEBMI_cat, PE$PEBMI_cat_factor, useNA = "ifany")
```

### Vital Signs

We create a date-time variable for vital signs.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding a column for the date-time variable for vital signs
VS <- VS %>% 
  mutate(
    date_time_vital_signs = as.POSIXct(x = paste(VSDAT, " ", VSTIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
    .after = VSTIM
  )
var_label(VS$date_time_vital_signs) <- "Date and time of vital signs"
dim(VS)
```

We create a continuous variable for change in maternal heart rate 30 minutes after the 1st IMP administration.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for the continuous variable for change in maternal heart rate 30 minutes after the 1st IMP administration
tmp <- VS %>% 
  arrange(SubjectId, EventId, ActivityId) %>% 
  group_by(SubjectId, EventId) %>% 
  mutate(VSPULSE_change_IMP1_30 = VSPULSE - lag(x = VSPULSE, n = 1, default = NULL)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1_30") %>% 
  select(SubjectId, EventId, ActivityId, VSPULSE_change_IMP1_30)
VS <- VS %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp, by = c("SubjectId", "EventId", "ActivityId")) %>% 
  relocate(VSPULSE_change_IMP1_30, .after = VSPULSE)
var_label(VS$VSPULSE_change_IMP1_30) <- "Change in maternal heart rate 30 minutes after the 1st IMP administration"
dim(VS)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Producing some summary statistics
summary(VS$VSPULSE_change_IMP1_30)
```

We create a dichotomous variable for Bishop score.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding a column for the dichotomous variable for Bishop score
VS <- VS %>% 
  mutate(
    VSBSCO_dich = case_when(
      VSBSCO < 6  ~ 0, 
      VSBSCO >= 6 ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    VSBSCO_dich_factor = factor(x = VSBSCO_dich, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("< 6", ">= 6")), 
    .after = VSBSCO
  )
var_label(VS$VSBSCO_dich) <- "Dichotomized Bishop score"

### Study Intervention

We correct some incorrect entries.

```{r, include = FALSE}
# Correcting some incorrect IMP date/time entries
EX <- EX %>% 
  mutate(
    EXDAT = case_when(
      SubjectId == "02-0297" & EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1" ~ EXDAT + 1, 
      SubjectId == "02-0471" & EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1" ~ EXDAT + 1, 
      SubjectId == "03-0001" & EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1" ~ EXDAT + 1, 
      .default = EXDAT
    )
  )
```

We create date-time variables for onset of active labor and IMP administration.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for the date-time variables for onset of active labor and IMP administration
EX <- EX %>% 
  mutate(
    date_time_onset_active_labor = as.POSIXct(x = paste(EXALDAT, " ", EXALTIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
    .after = EXALTIM
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    date_time_IMP_administration = as.POSIXct(x = paste(EXDAT, " ", EXTIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
    .after = EXTIM
  )
var_label(EX$date_time_onset_active_labor) <- "Date and time of onset of active labor"
var_label(EX$date_time_IMP_administration) <- "Date and time of IMP administration"
dim(EX)
```

### Delivery Information

We create date-time variables for delivery, cervical dilation of 10 cm, and start of active pushing.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for the date-time variables for delivery, cervical dilation of 10 cm, and start of active pushing
DE <- DE %>% 
  mutate(
    date_time_delivery = as.POSIXct(x = paste(DEDAT, " ", DETIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
    .after = DETIM
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    date_time_cervical_dilation_10_cm = as.POSIXct(x = paste(DE10DAT, " ", DE10TIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
    .after = DE10TIM
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    date_time_start_active_pushing = as.POSIXct(x = paste(DESTPDAT, " ", DESTPTIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
    .after = DESTPTIM
  )
var_label(DE$date_time_delivery) <- "Date and time of delivery"
var_label(DE$date_time_cervical_dilation_10_cm) <- "Date and time of cervical dilation of 10 cm"
var_label(DE$date_time_start_active_pushing) <- "Date and time of start of active pushing"
dim(DE)
```

var_label(DE$gestational_age_delivery) <- "Gestational age at delivery (days)"
dim(DE)
```

We create dichotomous and categorical variables for mode of delivery.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for the dichotomous variables and the categorical variable for mode of delivery
DE <- DE %>% 
  mutate(
    spontaneous_vaginal_delivery = case_when(
      DEMODECD == 2 ~ 0, 
      DEMODECD == 1 ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    spontaneous_vaginal_delivery_factor = factor(x = spontaneous_vaginal_delivery, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    vaginal_delivery = case_when(
      DEMODECD == 2 & (DEOPEDELCD == 3 | DEOPEDELCD == 5)                   ~ 0, 
      DEMODECD == 1                                                         ~ 1, 
      DEMODECD == 2 & (DEOPEDELCD == 1 | DEOPEDELCD == 2 | DEOPEDELCD == 4) ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    vaginal_delivery_factor = factor(x = vaginal_delivery, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    mode_of_delivery = case_when(
      DEMODECD == 1                                                         ~ 1, 
      DEMODECD == 2 & (DEOPEDELCD == 1 | DEOPEDELCD == 2 | DEOPEDELCD == 4) ~ 2, 
      DEMODECD == 2 & (DEOPEDELCD == 3 | DEOPEDELCD == 5)                   ~ 3, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    mode_of_delivery_factor = factor(x = mode_of_delivery, levels = c(1, 2, 3), labels = c("Spontaneous vaginal delivery", "Instrumental delivery", "Cesarean delivery")), 
    .after = DEOPEDELCD_factor
  )
var_label(DE$spontaneous_vaginal_delivery) <- "Spontaneous vaginal delivery"
var_label(DE$spontaneous_vaginal_delivery_factor) <- "Spontaneous vaginal delivery, factor"
var_label(DE$vaginal_delivery) <- "Vaginal delivery"
var_label(DE$vaginal_delivery_factor) <- "Vaginal delivery, factor"
var_label(DE$mode_of_delivery) <- "Mode of delivery"
var_label(DE$mode_of_delivery_factor) <- "Mode of delivery, factor"
dim(DE)
```

We create continuous variables for time from the onset of active labor to delivery (min), time from the 1st IMP administration to delivery (min), time from cervical dilation of 10 cm to delivery (min), time from start of active pushing to delivery (min), time from the onset of active labor to cervical dilation of 10 cm (min), and time from the 1st IMP administration to cervical dilation of 10 cm (min).

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for the continuous variables for time from the onset of active labor to delivery, time from the 1st IMP administration to delivery, time from cervical dilation of 10 cm to delivery, time from start of active pushing to delivery, time from the onset of active labor to cervical dilation of 10 cm, and time from the 1st IMP administration to cervical dilation of 10 cm
tmp1 <- EX %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01") %>% select(SubjectId, date_time_onset_active_labor)
tmp2 <- EX %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1") %>% select(SubjectId, date_time_IMP_administration)
DE <- DE %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  mutate(
    time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery = as.numeric(x = difftime(time1 = date_time_delivery, time2 = date_time_onset_active_labor, units = "mins")), 
    time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery = as.numeric(x = difftime(time1 = date_time_delivery, time2 = date_time_IMP_administration, units = "mins")), 
    time_from_cervical_dilation_10_cm_to_delivery = as.numeric(x = difftime(time1 = date_time_delivery, time2 = date_time_cervical_dilation_10_cm, units = "mins")), 
    time_from_start_active_pushing_to_delivery = as.numeric(x = difftime(time1 = date_time_delivery, time2 = date_time_start_active_pushing, units = "mins")), 
    time_from_onset_active_labor_to_cervical_dilation_10_cm = as.numeric(x = difftime(time1 = date_time_cervical_dilation_10_cm, time2 = date_time_onset_active_labor, units = "mins")), 
    time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_cervical_dilation_10_cm = as.numeric(x = difftime(time1 = date_time_cervical_dilation_10_cm, time2 = date_time_IMP_administration, units = "mins")), 
    .before = Treatment_allocated_str
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(date_time_onset_active_labor, date_time_IMP_administration))
var_label(DE$time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery) <- "Time from the onset of active labor to delivery (min)"
var_label(DE$time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery) <- "Time from the 1st IMP administration to delivery (min)"
var_label(DE$time_from_cervical_dilation_10_cm_to_delivery) <- "Time from cervical dilation of 10 cm to delivery (min)"
var_label(DE$time_from_start_active_pushing_to_delivery) <- "Time from start of active pushing to delivery (min)"
var_label(DE$time_from_onset_active_labor_to_cervical_dilation_10_cm) <- "Time from the onset of active labor to cervical dilation of 10 cm (min)"
var_label(DE$time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_cervical_dilation_10_cm) <- "Time from the 1st IMP administration to cervical dilation of 10 cm (min)"
dim(DE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Producing some summary statistics

summary(as.numeric(x = DE$time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery))
summary(as.numeric(x = DE$time_from_cervical_dilation_10_cm_to_delivery))
summary(as.numeric(x = DE$time_from_start_active_pushing_to_delivery))
summary(as.numeric(x = DE$time_from_onset_active_labor_to_cervical_dilation_10_cm))
summary(as.numeric(x = DE$time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_cervical_dilation_10_cm))
```

We create dichotomous variables for the type of event (event of interest or competing event) for different time variables.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for the dichotomous variables for the type of event (event of interest or competing event) for different time variables
# NOTE: A value of 1 corresponds to the event of interest, and a value of 2 corresponds to the competing event.
DE <- DE %>% 
  mutate(
    time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_event = 2 - spontaneous_vaginal_delivery, 
    time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_event_factor = factor(x = time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_event, levels = c(0, 1, 2), labels = c("Censoring", "Event of interest", "Competing event")), 
    .after = time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_event = 2 - spontaneous_vaginal_delivery, 
    time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_event_factor = factor(x = time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_event, levels = c(0, 1, 2), labels = c("Censoring", "Event of interest", "Competing event")), 
    .after = time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    time_from_cervical_dilation_10_cm_to_delivery_event = 2 - spontaneous_vaginal_delivery, 
    time_from_cervical_dilation_10_cm_to_delivery_event_factor = factor(x = time_from_cervical_dilation_10_cm_to_delivery_event, levels = c(0, 1, 2), labels = c("Censoring", "Event of interest", "Competing event")), 
    .after = time_from_cervical_dilation_10_cm_to_delivery
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    time_from_start_active_pushing_to_delivery_event = 2 - spontaneous_vaginal_delivery, 
    time_from_start_active_pushing_to_delivery_event_factor = factor(x = time_from_start_active_pushing_to_delivery_event, levels = c(0, 1, 2), labels = c("Censoring", "Event of interest", "Competing event")), 
    .after = time_from_start_active_pushing_to_delivery
  )
var_label(DE$time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_event) <- "Type of event for time from the onset of active labor to delivery"
var_label(DE$time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_event_factor) <- "Type of event for time from the onset of active labor to delivery, factor"
var_label(DE$time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_event) <- "Type of event for time from the 1st IMP administration to delivery"
var_label(DE$time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_event_factor) <- "Type of event for time from the 1st IMP administration to delivery, factor"
var_label(DE$time_from_cervical_dilation_10_cm_to_delivery_event) <- "Type of event for time from cervical dilation of 10 cm to delivery"
var_label(DE$time_from_cervical_dilation_10_cm_to_delivery_event_factor) <- "Type of event for time from cervical dilation of 10 cm to delivery, factor"
var_label(DE$time_from_start_active_pushing_to_delivery_event) <- "Type of event for time from start of active pushing to delivery"
var_label(DE$time_from_start_active_pushing_to_delivery_event_factor) <- "Type of event for time from start of active pushing to delivery, factor"
dim(DE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

We create continuous variables for mean cervical dilation rate.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for the continuous variables for mean cervical dilation rate
# NOTE: The 1st version disregards observations corresponding to cesarean section before cervical dilation of 10 cm.
# NOTE: The 2nd version also regards observations corresponding to cesarean section before cervical dilation of 10 cm.
# NOT: Time is calculated from the date and time of vital signs around 1st IMP administration. Should it be the date and time of the actual 1st IMP administration instead?
tmp1 <- VS %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1") %>% select(SubjectId, date_time_vital_signs, VSCD)
tmp2 <- EX %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1") %>% select(SubjectId, date_time_IMP_administration)
DE <- DE %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  mutate(
    tmp1 = as.numeric(x = difftime(time1 = date_time_cervical_dilation_10_cm, time2 = date_time_vital_signs, units = "hours")), 
    tmp2 = as.numeric(x = difftime(time1 = date_time_delivery, time2 = date_time_vital_signs, units = "hours")), 
    # tmp1 = as.numeric(x = difftime(time1 = date_time_cervical_dilation_10_cm, time2 = date_time_IMP_administration, units = "hours")), 
    # tmp2 = as.numeric(x = difftime(time1 = date_time_delivery, time2 = date_time_IMP_administration, units = "hours")), 
    mean_cervical_dilation_rate1 = (10 - VSCD) / tmp1, 
    mean_cervical_dilation_rate1_pos_fin = if_else(condition = mean_cervical_dilation_rate1 < 0 | is.infinite(mean_cervical_dilation_rate1), true = NA, false = mean_cervical_dilation_rate1, missing = NULL), 
    mean_cervical_dilation_rate2 = if_else(
      condition = cervical_dilation_cesarean_section < 10, 
      true = (cervical_dilation_cesarean_section - VSCD) / tmp2, 
      false = mean_cervical_dilation_rate1, 
      missing = mean_cervical_dilation_rate1
    ), 
    mean_cervical_dilation_rate2_pos_fin = if_else(condition = mean_cervical_dilation_rate2 < 0 | is.infinite(mean_cervical_dilation_rate2), true = NA, false = mean_cervical_dilation_rate2, missing = NULL), 
    .before = Treatment_allocated_str
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(date_time_vital_signs, VSCD, date_time_IMP_administration, tmp1, tmp2))
var_label(DE$mean_cervical_dilation_rate1) <- "Mean cervical dilation rate (cm/h), version 1"
var_label(DE$mean_cervical_dilation_rate1_pos_fin) <- "Mean cervical dilation rate (cm/h), version 1 (negative and infinite values set to missing)"
var_label(DE$mean_cervical_dilation_rate2) <- "Mean cervical dilation rate (cm/h), version 2"
var_label(DE$mean_cervical_dilation_rate2_pos_fin) <- "Mean cervical dilation rate (cm/h), version 2 (negative and infinite values set to missing)"
dim(DE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Producing some summary statistics
summary(DE$mean_cervical_dilation_rate1)
summary(DE$mean_cervical_dilation_rate1_pos_fin)
summary(DE$mean_cervical_dilation_rate2)
summary(DE$mean_cervical_dilation_rate2_pos_fin)
```

We create date-time variables for start and end of oxytocin administration and continuous variables for total time of oxytocin administration and total amount of oxytocin administered.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for the date-time variables for start and end of oxytocin administration and the continuous variables for total time of oxytocin administration and total amount of oxytocin administered during labor
DE <- DE %>% 
  mutate(
    date_time_oxytocin_start = as.POSIXct(x = paste(DEOSTDAT, " ", DEOSTTIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
    date_time_oxytocin_end = as.POSIXct(x = paste(DEOENDAT, " ", DEOENTIM, sep = ""), tz = "", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
    total_time_oxytocin = if_else(
      condition = is.na(date_time_oxytocin_start) & is.na(date_time_oxytocin_end) & DEOXYYNCD == 0, 
      true = 0, 
      false = as.numeric(x = difftime(time1 = date_time_oxytocin_end, time2 = date_time_oxytocin_start, units = "mins")), 
      missing = as.numeric(x = difftime(time1 = date_time_oxytocin_end, time2 = date_time_oxytocin_start, units = "mins"))
    ), 
    .after = DEOENTIM
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    total_amount_oxytocin1 = if_else(
      condition = is.na(DEOXY) & DEOXYYNCD == 0, 
      true = 0, 
      false = DEOXY, 
      missing = DEOXY
    ), 
    total_amount_oxytocin2 = total_amount_oxytocin1 / 100, 
    .after = DEOXY
  )
var_label(DE$date_time_oxytocin_start) <- "Date and time of start of oxytocin administration"
var_label(DE$date_time_oxytocin_end) <- "Date and time of end of oxytocin administration"
var_label(DE$total_time_oxytocin) <- "Total time of oxytocin administration (min)"
var_label(DE$total_amount_oxytocin1) <- "Total amount of oxytocin administered (mL)"
var_label(DE$total_amount_oxytocin2) <- "Total amount of oxytocin administered (IU)"
dim(DE)
```

DE <- DE %>% 
  mutate(
    urinary_retention_delivery_ward = case_when(
      DEURCYNCD == 0 & is.na(DEURC1CD)                                   ~ 0, 
      DEURCYNCD == 1 & is.na(DEURC1CD) & (DEURC2CD == 2 | DEURC3CD == 3) ~ 0, 
      DEURCYNCD == 1 & DEURC1CD == 1                                     ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    urinary_retention_delivery_ward_factor = factor(x = urinary_retention_delivery_ward, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    urinary_retention_postnatal_ward = case_when(
      DEURCYNCD == 0 & is.na(DEURC3CD)                                   ~ 0, 
      DEURCYNCD == 1 & is.na(DEURC3CD) & (DEURC1CD == 1 | DEURC2CD == 2) ~ 0, 
      DEURCYNCD == 1 & DEURC3CD == 3                                     ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    urinary_retention_postnatal_ward_factor = factor(x = urinary_retention_postnatal_ward, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    urinary_retention_hospital_discharge = case_when(
      DEURCDISCD == 0 ~ 0, 
      DEURCDISCD == 1 ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    urinary_retention_hospital_discharge_factor = factor(x = urinary_retention_hospital_discharge, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    .after = DEURCDISCD_factor
  )
var_label(DE$urinary_retention_delivery_ward) <- "Urinary retention in the delivery ward"
var_label(DE$urinary_retention_delivery_ward_factor) <- "Urinary retention in the delivery ward, factor"
var_label(DE$urinary_retention_postnatal_ward) <- "Urinary retention in the postnatal ward"
var_label(DE$urinary_retention_postnatal_ward_factor) <- "Urinary retention in the postnatal ward, factor"
var_label(DE$urinary_retention_hospital_discharge) <- "Urinary retention at hospital discharge"
var_label(DE$urinary_retention_hospital_discharge_factor) <- "Urinary retention at hospital discharge, factor"
dim(DE)
```

```{r, include = TRUE}

      NSPHART >= 7.0 ~ 0, 
      NSPHART < 7.0  ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    NSPHART_dich1_factor = factor(x = NSPHART_dich1, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    NSPHART_dich2 = case_when(
      NSPHART >= 7.1 ~ 0, 
      NSPHART < 7.1  ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    NSPHART_dich2_factor = factor(x = NSPHART_dich2, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    NSPHART_dich3 = case_when(
      NSPHART >= 7.2 ~ 0, 
      NSPHART < 7.2  ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    NSPHART_dich3_factor = factor(x = NSPHART_dich3, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    .after = NSPHART
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    NSPHVENE_dich1 = case_when(

      .default = NULL
    ), 
    NSPHVENE_dich1_factor = factor(x = NSPHVENE_dich1, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    NSPHVENE_dich2 = case_when(
      NSPHVENE >= 7.2 ~ 0, 
      NSPHVENE < 7.2  ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    NSPHVENE_dich2_factor = factor(x = NSPHVENE_dich2, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    .after = NSPHVENE
  )

### Childbirth Experience Questionnaire

We change the IDs of two subjects whose IDs have been swapped.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Changing the IDs of two subjects
# NOTE: Subject IDs 03-0361 and 03-0362 have been swapped.
# NOTE: Subject IDs 03-0576 and 03-0577 have been swapped.
CEQ %>% mutate(tmp = row_number()) %>% filter(SubjectId == "03-0361" | SubjectId == "03-0362" | SubjectId == "03-0576" | SubjectId == "03-0577") %>% select(SubjectId, tmp)
CEQ <- CEQ %>% 
  mutate(
    SubjectId = case_when(
      SubjectId == "03-0361" ~ "03-0362", 
      SubjectId == "03-0362" ~ "03-0361", 
      SubjectId == "03-0576" ~ "03-0577", 
      SubjectId == "03-0577" ~ "03-0576", 
      .default = SubjectId
    )
  )
CEQ %>% mutate(tmp = row_number()) %>% filter(SubjectId == "03-0361" | SubjectId == "03-0362" | SubjectId == "03-0576" | SubjectId == "03-0577") %>% select(SubjectId, tmp)
```

We create categorical variables for items 20--22.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Categorizing the variables corresponding to items 20-22
for (i in 20:22) {
  CEQ <- CEQ %>% 
    rename(tmp1 = paste("CEQ", i, sep = "")) %>% 
    mutate(
      tmp2 = case_when(
        tmp1 >= 0 & tmp1 <= 40   ~ 1, 
        tmp1 >= 41 & tmp1 <= 60  ~ 2, 
        tmp1 >= 61 & tmp1 <= 80  ~ 3, 
        tmp1 >= 81 & tmp1 <= 100 ~ 4, 
        .default = NULL
      ), 
      .after = tmp1
    ) %>% 
    rename_with(.fn = ~ paste("CEQ", i, sep = ""), .cols = tmp1) %>% 
    rename_with(.fn = ~ paste("CEQ", i, "CD", sep = ""), .cols = tmp2)
}
dim(CEQ)
rm(i)
```

table(CEQ$CEQ21, CEQ$CEQ21CD, useNA = "ifany")
table(CEQ$CEQ22, CEQ$CEQ22CD, useNA = "ifany")
```

We create categorical variables for the inverse of items 1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 10--20.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Inversing the values of the variables corresponding to items 1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 10-20
# NOTE: These are the positively worded statements.
for (i in c(1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 10:20)) {
  CEQ <- CEQ %>% 
    rename(tmp1 = paste("CEQ", i, "CD", sep = "")) %>% 
    rename(tmp2 = paste("CEQ", i + 1, sep = "")) %>% 
    mutate(
      tmp3 = case_when(
        tmp1 == 4 ~ 1, 
        tmp1 == 3 ~ 2, 
        tmp1 == 2 ~ 3, 
        tmp1 == 1 ~ 4, 
        .default = NULL
      ), 
      .before = tmp2
    ) %>% 
    rename_with(.fn = ~ paste("CEQ", i, "CD", sep = ""), .cols = tmp1) %>% 
    rename_with(.fn = ~ paste("CEQ", i + 1, sep = ""), .cols = tmp2) %>% 
    rename_with(.fn = ~ paste("CEQ", i, "CD_inv", sep = ""), .cols = tmp3)
}
dim(CEQ)
rm(i)
```

We create continuous variables for the mean overall CEQ score and the mean CEQ subscores for the four different dimensions.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Calculating the mean overall CEQ score and the mean CEQ subscores for the four different dimensions
CEQ <- CEQ %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    tmp1 = sum(is.na(c(CEQ1CD_inv, CEQ2CD_inv, CEQ3CD, CEQ4CD_inv, CEQ5CD, CEQ6CD_inv, CEQ7CD_inv, CEQ8CD, CEQ9CD, CEQ10CD_inv, CEQ11CD_inv, CEQ12CD_inv, CEQ13CD_inv, CEQ14CD_inv, CEQ15CD_inv, CEQ16CD_inv, CEQ17CD_inv, CEQ18CD_inv, CEQ19CD_inv, CEQ20CD_inv, CEQ21CD, CEQ22CD)), na.rm = FALSE), 
    tmp2 = sum(!is.na(c(CEQ1CD_inv, CEQ2CD_inv, CEQ3CD, CEQ4CD_inv, CEQ5CD, CEQ6CD_inv, CEQ7CD_inv, CEQ8CD, CEQ9CD, CEQ10CD_inv, CEQ11CD_inv, CEQ12CD_inv, CEQ13CD_inv, CEQ14CD_inv, CEQ15CD_inv, CEQ16CD_inv, CEQ17CD_inv, CEQ18CD_inv, CEQ19CD_inv, CEQ20CD_inv, CEQ21CD, CEQ22CD)), na.rm = FALSE), 
    tmp3 = mean(c(CEQ1CD_inv, CEQ2CD_inv, CEQ3CD, CEQ4CD_inv, CEQ5CD, CEQ6CD_inv, CEQ7CD_inv, CEQ8CD, CEQ9CD, CEQ10CD_inv, CEQ11CD_inv, CEQ12CD_inv, CEQ13CD_inv, CEQ14CD_inv, CEQ15CD_inv, CEQ16CD_inv, CEQ17CD_inv, CEQ18CD_inv, CEQ19CD_inv, CEQ20CD_inv, CEQ21CD, CEQ22CD), na.rm = TRUE), 
    mean_overall_CEQ_score = if_else(condition = tmp1 / (tmp1 + tmp2) > 50, true = NA, false = tmp3, missing = NULL)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    tmp1 = sum(is.na(c(CEQ1CD_inv, CEQ2CD_inv, CEQ4CD_inv, CEQ5CD, CEQ6CD_inv, CEQ19CD_inv, CEQ20CD_inv, CEQ21CD)), na.rm = FALSE), 
    tmp2 = sum(!is.na(c(CEQ1CD_inv, CEQ2CD_inv, CEQ4CD_inv, CEQ5CD, CEQ6CD_inv, CEQ19CD_inv, CEQ20CD_inv, CEQ21CD)), na.rm = FALSE), 
    tmp3 = mean(c(CEQ1CD_inv, CEQ2CD_inv, CEQ4CD_inv, CEQ5CD, CEQ6CD_inv, CEQ19CD_inv, CEQ20CD_inv, CEQ21CD), na.rm = TRUE), 
    mean_CEQ_subscore_own_capacity = if_else(condition = tmp1 / (tmp1 + tmp2) > 50, true = NA, false = tmp3, missing = NULL)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    tmp1 = sum(is.na(c(CEQ13CD_inv, CEQ14CD_inv, CEQ15CD_inv, CEQ16CD_inv, CEQ17CD_inv)), na.rm = FALSE), 
    tmp2 = sum(!is.na(c(CEQ13CD_inv, CEQ14CD_inv, CEQ15CD_inv, CEQ16CD_inv, CEQ17CD_inv)), na.rm = FALSE), 
    tmp3 = mean(c(CEQ13CD_inv, CEQ14CD_inv, CEQ15CD_inv, CEQ16CD_inv, CEQ17CD_inv), na.rm = TRUE), 
    mean_CEQ_subscore_professional_support = if_else(condition = tmp1 / (tmp1 + tmp2) > 50, true = NA, false = tmp3, missing = NULL)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    tmp1 = sum(is.na(c(CEQ3CD, CEQ7CD_inv, CEQ8CD, CEQ9CD, CEQ18CD_inv, CEQ22CD)), na.rm = FALSE), 
    tmp2 = sum(!is.na(c(CEQ3CD, CEQ7CD_inv, CEQ8CD, CEQ9CD, CEQ18CD_inv, CEQ22CD)), na.rm = FALSE), 
    tmp3 = mean(c(CEQ3CD, CEQ7CD_inv, CEQ8CD, CEQ9CD, CEQ18CD_inv, CEQ22CD), na.rm = TRUE), 
    mean_CEQ_subscore_perceived_safety = if_else(condition = tmp1 / (tmp1 + tmp2) > 50, true = NA, false = tmp3, missing = NULL)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    tmp1 = sum(is.na(c(CEQ10CD_inv, CEQ11CD_inv, CEQ12CD_inv)), na.rm = FALSE), 
    tmp2 = sum(!is.na(c(CEQ10CD_inv, CEQ11CD_inv, CEQ12CD_inv)), na.rm = FALSE), 
    tmp3 = mean(c(CEQ10CD_inv, CEQ11CD_inv, CEQ12CD_inv), na.rm = TRUE), 
    mean_CEQ_subscore_participation = if_else(condition = tmp1 / (tmp1 + tmp2) > 50, true = NA, false = tmp3, missing = NULL)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  relocate(mean_overall_CEQ_score, mean_CEQ_subscore_own_capacity, mean_CEQ_subscore_professional_support, mean_CEQ_subscore_perceived_safety, mean_CEQ_subscore_participation, .after = CEQ22CD) %>% 
  select(-c(tmp1, tmp2, tmp3))
var_label(CEQ$mean_overall_CEQ_score) <- "Mean overall CEQ score"
var_label(CEQ$mean_CEQ_subscore_own_capacity) <- "Mean CEQ subscore for own capacity"
var_label(CEQ$mean_CEQ_subscore_professional_support) <- "Mean CEQ subscore for professional support"
var_label(CEQ$mean_CEQ_subscore_perceived_safety) <- "Mean CEQ subscore for perceived safety"
var_label(CEQ$mean_CEQ_subscore_participation) <- "Mean CEQ subscore for participation"
dim(CEQ)
```

summary(CEQ$mean_CEQ_subscore_own_capacity)
summary(CEQ$mean_CEQ_subscore_professional_support)
summary(CEQ$mean_CEQ_subscore_perceived_safety)
summary(CEQ$mean_CEQ_subscore_participation)
```

We create a continuous variable for duration of partner's sick leave during the first month after birth.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for the continuous variable for length of stay in the ICU
# NOTE: We replace all values exceeding 31 with the number of days in the month of birth.
tmp <- DE %>% select(SubjectId, DEDAT)
CEQ <- CEQ %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  mutate(
    duration_partner_sick_leave = if_else(
      condition = is.na(CEQ28NO) & CEQ28CD == 0, 
      true = 0, 
      false = if_else(
        condition = CEQ28NO > 31, 
        true = as.numeric(x = days_in_month(x = DEDAT)), 
        false = CEQ28NO, 
        missing = CEQ28NO
      ), 
      missing = CEQ28NO
    ), 
    .after = CEQ28NO
  )
var_label(CEQ$duration_partner_sick_leave) <- "Duration of partner's sick leave during the first month after birth (days)"
dim(CEQ)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}

summary(CEQ$duration_partner_sick_leave[which(CEQ$CEQ28CD == 0)])

summary(CEQ$duration_partner_sick_leave[which(is.na(CEQ$CEQ28CD))])
```

### Adverse Event

We create categorical variables for system organ class and preferred term according to the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE). We also add complications in the DE and MCD forms if they are not already registered in the AE form.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for system organ class and preferred term
AE <- AE %>% 
  left_join(y = MedDRA %>% filter(EventId == "AE" & ActivityId == "AE" & FormId == "AE" & ItemId == "AETERM") %>% rename(AETERM = Term) %>% select(SubjectId, EventSeq, EventId, EventDate, ActivityId, FormSeq, SubjectFormSeq, OriginSubjectFormSeq, SourceSubjectFormSeq, AETERM, CodeSeqNumber, soc_name, pt_name), by = c("SubjectId", "EventSeq", "EventId", "EventDate", "ActivityId", "FormSeq", "SubjectFormSeq", "OriginSubjectFormSeq", "SourceSubjectFormSeq", "AETERM")) %>% 
  relocate(CodeSeqNumber, soc_name, pt_name, .after = AETERM)
dim(AE)

# Adding rows of complications not already registered as adverse events
# NOTE: Consider the lists on pages 17 and 41 in the SAINT_6.0_Annotated.pdf document.
# NOTE: The code assumes that all registered AEs with system organ class name "Infections and infestations" are pregnancy-related infections. Check the data to verify this.
tmp1 <- 1:9
tmp2 <- list()
for (i in 1:length(tmp1)) {
  tmp2[[i]] <- DE %>% 
    rename(
      DECOMP = paste("DECOMP", tmp1[i], sep = ""), 
      DECOMPCD = paste("DECOMP", tmp1[i], "CD", sep = "")
    ) %>% 
    filter(DECOMPCD == tmp1[i]) %>% 
    select(SiteSeq, SiteName, SiteCode, SubjectSeq, SubjectId, DECOMP, DECOMPCD, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
    mutate(
      EventId = "AE", 
      EventName = "Adverse Events", 
      ActivityId = "AE", 
      soc_name = case_when(
        DECOMP == "Abruption"             ~ "Pregnancy, puerperium and perinatal conditions", 
        DECOMP == "Eclampsia"             ~ "Pregnancy, puerperium and perinatal conditions", 
        DECOMP == "Fever >38 degrees"     ~ "General disorders and administration site conditions", 
        DECOMP == "Amnion fluid embolism" ~ "Pregnancy, puerperium and perinatal conditions", 
        DECOMP == "Infection"             ~ "Infections and infestations", 
        DECOMP == "Uterine rupture"       ~ "Pregnancy, puerperium and perinatal conditions", 
        DECOMP == "Shoulder dystocia"     ~ "Pregnancy, puerperium and perinatal conditions", 
        DECOMP == "Retained placenta"     ~ "Pregnancy, puerperium and perinatal conditions", 
        DECOMP == "Maternal death"        ~ "Pregnancy, puerperium and perinatal conditions", 
        .default = NULL
      ), 
      pt_name = case_when(
        DECOMP == "Abruption"             ~ "Premature separation of placenta", 
        DECOMP == "Eclampsia"             ~ "Eclampsia", 
        DECOMP == "Fever >38 degrees"     ~ "Pyrexia", 
        DECOMP == "Amnion fluid embolism" ~ "Anaphylactoid syndrome of pregnancy", 
        DECOMP == "Infection"             ~ "Pregnancy related infection", 
        DECOMP == "Uterine rupture"       ~ "Uterine rupture", 
        DECOMP == "Shoulder dystocia"     ~ "Shoulder dystocia", 
        DECOMP == "Retained placenta"     ~ "Retained placenta or membranes", 
        DECOMP == "Maternal death"        ~ "Maternal death", 
        .default = NULL
      ), 
      .after = DECOMPCD
    )
}
tmp3 <- 2:14
tmp4 <- list()
for (i in 1:length(tmp3)) {
  tmp4[[i]] <- MCD %>% 
    rename(
      MCDCOMP = paste("MCDCOMP", tmp3[i], sep = ""), 
      MCDCOMPCD = paste("MCDCOMP", tmp3[i], "CD", sep = "")
    ) %>% 
    filter(MCDCOMPCD == tmp3[i]) %>% 
    select(SiteSeq, SiteName, SiteCode, SubjectSeq, SubjectId, MCDCOMP, MCDCOMPCD, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
    mutate(
      EventId = "AE", 
      EventName = "Adverse Events", 
      ActivityId = "AE", 
      soc_name = case_when(
        MCDCOMP == "HELLP"                   ~ "Pregnancy, puerperium and perinatal conditions", 
        MCDCOMP == "Eclampsia"               ~ "Pregnancy, puerperium and perinatal conditions", 
        MCDCOMP == "Fever >38.5 C"           ~ "General disorders and administration site conditions", 
        MCDCOMP == "Endometritis"            ~ "Infections and infestations", 
        MCDCOMP == "Post-cesarean infection" ~ "Infections and infestations", 
        MCDCOMP == "Infection, breast"       ~ "Infections and infestations", 
        MCDCOMP == "Infection, wound"        ~ "Infections and infestations", 
        MCDCOMP == "Pneumonia"               ~ "Infections and infestations", 
        MCDCOMP == "Urinary tract infection" ~ "Infections and infestations", 
        MCDCOMP == "Sepsis"                  ~ "Infections and infestations", 
        MCDCOMP == "Spinal headache"         ~ "Injury, poisoning and procedural complications", 
        MCDCOMP == "Thrombosis"              ~ "Vascular disorders", 
        MCDCOMP == "Revisio"                 ~ "Surgical and medical procedures", 
        .default = NULL
      ), 
      pt_name = case_when(
        MCDCOMP == "HELLP"                   ~ "HELLP syndrome", 
        MCDCOMP == "Eclampsia"               ~ "Eclampsia", 
        MCDCOMP == "Fever >38.5 C"           ~ "Pyrexia", 
        MCDCOMP == "Endometritis"            ~ "Endometritis", 
        MCDCOMP == "Post-cesarean infection" ~ "Post procedural infection", 
        MCDCOMP == "Infection, breast"       ~ "Mastitis", 
        MCDCOMP == "Infection, wound"        ~ "Wound infection", 
        MCDCOMP == "Pneumonia"               ~ "Pneumonia", 
        MCDCOMP == "Urinary tract infection" ~ "Urinary tract infection", 
        MCDCOMP == "Sepsis"                  ~ "Sepsis", 
        MCDCOMP == "Spinal headache"         ~ "Post lumbar puncture syndrome", 
        MCDCOMP == "Thrombosis"              ~ "Thrombosis", 
        MCDCOMP == "Revisio"                 ~ "Uterine dilation and evacuation", 
        .default = NULL
      ), 
      .after = MCDCOMPCD
    )
}
tmp5 <- bind_rows(tmp2, tmp4) %>% 
  group_by(SiteSeq, SiteName, SiteCode, SubjectSeq, SubjectId, EventId, EventName, ActivityId, soc_name, pt_name, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>%

    tmp1 = soc_name == "Infections and infestations" & pt_name == "Pregnancy related infection",

    tmp3 = sum(tmp2, na.rm = TRUE),
