### Concomitant Medication

We create categorical variables for main anatomical/pharmacological group and chemical substance for concomitant medication.

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for main anatomical or pharmacological group and chemical substance
CM <- ATC_without_DDD %>% 
  filter(EventId == "CM" & ActivityId == "CM" & FormId == "CM" & ItemId == "CMTRT") %>% 
  rename(CMTRT = Term) %>% 
  mutate(
    L1name = paste(toupper(x = substr(x = L1name, start = 1, stop = 1)), tolower(x = substr(x = L1name, start = 2, stop = nchar(L1name))), sep = ""), 
    L5name = paste(toupper(x = substr(x = L5name, start = 1, stop = 1)), tolower(x = substr(x = L5name, start = 2, stop = nchar(L5name))), sep = "")
  ) %>% 
  select(SubjectId, EventSeq, EventId, EventDate, ActivityId, FormSeq, SubjectFormSeq, OriginSubjectFormSeq, SourceSubjectFormSeq, CMTRT, CodeSeqNumber, L1name, L5name) %>% 
  left_join(x = CM, by = c("SubjectId", "EventSeq", "EventId", "EventDate", "ActivityId", "FormSeq", "SubjectFormSeq", "OriginSubjectFormSeq", "SourceSubjectFormSeq", "CMTRT")) %>% 
  relocate(CodeSeqNumber, L1name, L5name, .after = CMTRT)
dim(CM)
```

### Medical History

We create categorical variables for system organ class and preferred term according to the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE).

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Adding columns for system organ class and preferred term
MH <- MedDRA %>% 
  filter(EventId == "MH" & ActivityId == "MH" & FormId == "MH" & ItemId == "MHTERM") %>% 
  rename(MHTERM = Term) %>% 
  select(SubjectId, EventSeq, EventId, EventDate, ActivityId, FormSeq, SubjectFormSeq, OriginSubjectFormSeq, SourceSubjectFormSeq, MHTERM, CodeSeqNumber, soc_name, pt_name) %>% 
  left_join(x = MH, by = c("SubjectId", "EventSeq", "EventId", "EventDate", "ActivityId", "FormSeq", "SubjectFormSeq", "OriginSubjectFormSeq", "SourceSubjectFormSeq", "MHTERM")) %>% 
  relocate(CodeSeqNumber, soc_name, pt_name, .after = MHTERM)
dim(MH)
```

# Analysis Sets

We define the following *four* analysis sets:

1. Intention-to-treat (ITT) set
2. Full-analysis (FA) set
3. Per-protocol (PP) set
4. Safety set

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Defining the complete set
complete_set <- EX %>% 
  filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01") %>% 
  arrange(SubjectId) %>% 
  select(SubjectId, SiteName, SiteCode, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num)
dim(complete_set)
complete_set
```

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Defining the randomized set
# NOTE: Subjects 08-0111 and 11-0021 are missing KIT number. Were they never randomized?
# NOTE: Subjects 02-0168 and 02-0750 got the same kit (1692). Subject 02-0750 is therefore regarded as not randomized.
tmp1 <- EX %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01" & is.na(EXKITNO))
tmp2 <- EX %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01" & SubjectId == "02-0750")
randomized_set <- complete_set %>% 
  anti_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  anti_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId")
dim(randomized_set)
randomized_set
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Exporting the randomized set to an Excel file
tmp <- randomized_set %>% 
  left_join(y = EX %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01") %>% select(SubjectId, EXKITNO), by = "SubjectId")
write_xlsx(x = tmp, path = file.path(getwd(), "Output Files", "Randomized Set - Included Subjects.xlsx"), col_names = TRUE, format_headers = TRUE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Defining the inverse (i.e., complement) of the randomized set
# NOTE: This assumes that the complete set is the universal set.
inverse_randomized_set <- complete_set %>% 
  anti_join(y = randomized_set, by = "SubjectId")
dim(inverse_randomized_set)
inverse_randomized_set
```

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Exporting the inverse (i.e., complement) of the randomized set to an Excel file
# NOTE: This assumes that the complete set is the universal set.
tmp <- inverse_randomized_set %>% 
  left_join(y = EX %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01") %>% select(SubjectId, EXKITNO), by = "SubjectId")
write_xlsx(x = tmp, path = file.path(getwd(), "Output Files", "Randomized Set - Excluded Subjects.xlsx"), col_names = TRUE, format_headers = TRUE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

A total of `r dim(randomized_set)[1]` subjects have been randomized. The main analysis of each endpoint will be based on FA set -- both in the interim analysis and in the final analysis -- unless otherwise stated. Sensitivity analyses based on the ITT set and the PP set will also be conducted for comparison reasons as part of the final analysis only. Descriptive safety analyses will be based on the safety set.

In the following, by *eligible* subjects we mean subjects fulfilling all of the inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria, and by *treated* subjects we mean subjects who have received at least one dose of the investigational medicinal product (IMP).

## ITT Set

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Defining the ITT set
# NOTE: Subjects 01-0030 and 01-0038 are missing date of written informed consent. This protocol deviation is categorized as unimportant for both trial participants.
# NOTE: Should subjects who later revoke their informed consent be excluded from the analysis sets?
tmp <- DV %>% filter(DVCATCD == 6 & DVPLCLASCD == 1)
ITT_set <- randomized_set %>% 
  anti_join(y = tmp, by = "SubjectId")
dim(ITT_set)
ITT_set
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Exporting the ITT set to an Excel file
tmp <- ITT_set %>% 
  left_join(y = DV %>% filter(DVCATCD == 6 & DVPLCLASCD == 1) %>% select(SubjectId, DVCAT, DVPLCLAS), by = "SubjectId")
write_xlsx(x = tmp, path = file.path(getwd(), "Output Files", "ITT Set - Included Subjects.xlsx"), col_names = TRUE, format_headers = TRUE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Defining the inverse (i.e., complement) of the ITT set
# NOTE: This assumes that the randomized set is the universal set.
inverse_ITT_set <- randomized_set %>% 
  anti_join(y = ITT_set, by = "SubjectId")
dim(inverse_ITT_set)
inverse_ITT_set
```

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Exporting the inverse (i.e., complement) of the ITT set to an Excel file
# NOTE: This assumes that the randomized set is the universal set.
tmp <- inverse_ITT_set %>% 
  left_join(y = DV %>% filter(DVCATCD == 6 & DVPLCLASCD == 1) %>% select(SubjectId, DVCAT, DVPLCLAS), by = "SubjectId")
write_xlsx(x = tmp, path = file.path(getwd(), "Output Files", "ITT Set - Excluded Subjects.xlsx"), col_names = TRUE, format_headers = TRUE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

The *ITT set* (*n* = `r dim(ITT_set)[1]`) includes all randomized subjects with a signed informed consent, regardless of protocol adherence, classified according to the allocated treatment.

## FA Set

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Defining the FA set
# NOTE: Subjects with a protocol deviation related to informed consent (DVCATCD = 6) classified as important (DVPLCLASCD = 1) are already excluded from the ITT set in the code above.
tmp1 <- DV %>% filter(DVCATCD == 1 & DVPLCLASCD == 1)
tmp2 <- IE %>% filter(IEYNCD_edited == 1)
tmp3 <- EX %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01" & EXNRDOSE != 0)
FA_set <- ITT_set %>% 
  anti_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  semi_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  semi_join(y = tmp3, by = "SubjectId")
dim(FA_set)
FA_set
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Exporting the FA set to an Excel file
tmp <- FA_set %>% 
  left_join(y = IE %>% select(SubjectId, IEYN, IEYN_edited, IEINCLYN, IEIN1, IEIN1_edited, IEIN2, IEIN2_edited, IEIN3, IEIN3_edited, IEIN4, IEIN4_edited, IEEX1, IEEX1_edited, IEEX2, IEEX2_edited, IEEX3, IEEX3_edited, IEEX4, IEEX4_edited, IEEX5, IEEX5_edited, IEEX6, IEEX6_edited, IEEX7, IEEX7_edited, IEEX8, IEEX8_edited, IEEX9, IEEX9_edited, IEEX10, IEEX10_edited), by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = DM %>% select(SubjectId, DMAGE), by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = LB %>% select(SubjectId, LBCRERES, LBSODRES, LBPOTRES, LBALTRES), by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = IN %>% select(SubjectId, ININD, INOTHM), by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = MH %>% select(SubjectId, MHCAT, MHPRC, MHTERM, pt_name), by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = DV %>% filter(DVCATCD == 1 & DVPLCLASCD == 1) %>% select(SubjectId, DVCAT, DVPLCLAS), by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = EX %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01") %>% select(SubjectId, EXNRDOSE), by = "SubjectId")
write_xlsx(x = tmp, path = file.path(getwd(), "Output Files", "FA Set - Included Subjects.xlsx"), col_names = TRUE, format_headers = TRUE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Exporting the inverse (i.e., complement) of the FA set, version 2, to an Excel file
# NOTE: This assumes that the randomized set is the universal set.
# NOTE: This is to be used in the flow diagram.
tmp1 <- DV %>% filter(DVCATCD == 6 & DVPLCLASCD == 1) %>% group_by(SubjectId) %>% summarize(protocol_deviation_signed_informed_consent = 1, .groups = "drop")
tmp2 <- DV %>% filter(DVCATCD == 1 & DVPLCLASCD == 1) %>% group_by(SubjectId) %>% summarize(protocol_deviation_eligibility = 1, .groups = "drop")
tmp3 <- IE %>% select(SubjectId, IEYN_edited, IEIN1_edited, IEIN2_edited, IEIN3_edited, IEIN4_edited, IEEX1_edited, IEEX2_edited, IEEX3_edited, IEEX4_edited, IEEX5_edited, IEEX6_edited, IEEX7_edited, IEEX8_edited, IEEX9_edited, IEEX10_edited)
tmp4 <- EX %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01") %>% select(SubjectId, EXNRDOSE)
tmp5 <- inverse_FA_set2 %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp4, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  mutate(
    ineligibility = if_else(condition = protocol_deviation_eligibility == 1 | IEYN_edited == "No", true = 1, false = NA, missing = NULL), 
    no_IMP = if_else(condition = EXNRDOSE == 0, true = 1, false = 0, missing = NULL)
  )
tmp6 <- tmp5 %>% filter(Treatment_allocated_str == "Peroral bicarbonate & intravenous hyoscine butylbromide")
tmp7 <- tmp5 %>% filter(Treatment_allocated_str == "Peroral bicarbonate & intravenous placebo")
tmp8 <- tmp5 %>% filter(Treatment_allocated_str == "Peroral placebo & intravenous hyoscine butylbromide")
tmp9 <- tmp5 %>% filter(Treatment_allocated_str == "Peroral placebo & intravenous placebo")
table(tmp5$Treatment_allocated_str, tmp5$protocol_deviation_signed_informed_consent, useNA = "ifany")
table(tmp5$Treatment_allocated_str, tmp5$ineligibility, useNA = "ifany")
table(tmp5$Treatment_allocated_str, tmp5$EXNRDOSE, useNA = "ifany")
table(tmp6$protocol_deviation_signed_informed_consent, tmp6$ineligibility, tmp6$no_IMP, useNA = "ifany")
table(tmp7$protocol_deviation_signed_informed_consent, tmp7$ineligibility, tmp7$no_IMP, useNA = "ifany")
table(tmp8$protocol_deviation_signed_informed_consent, tmp8$ineligibility, tmp8$no_IMP, useNA = "ifany")
table(tmp9$protocol_deviation_signed_informed_consent, tmp9$ineligibility, tmp9$no_IMP, useNA = "ifany")
write_xlsx(x = tmp5, path = file.path(getwd(), "Output Files", "FA Set - Excluded Subjects - Numbers for Flow Diagram.xlsx"), col_names = TRUE, format_headers = TRUE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

The *FA set* (*n* = `r dim(FA_set)[1]`) includes all eligible and treated subjects in the ITT set, classified according to the allocated treatment.

## PP Set

```{r, include = TRUE}
# Defining the per-protocol set
# NOTE: Subjects with a protocol deviation related to informed consent (DVCATCD = 6) classified as important (DVPLCLASCD = 1) are already excluded from the ITT set in the code above.
# NOTE: Subjects with a protocol deviation related to eligibility (DVCATCD = 1) classified as important (DVPLCLASCD = 1) are already excluded from the FA set in the code above.
tmp1 <- DV %>% filter(((DVCATCD == 2 | DVCATCD == 4 | DVCATCD == 7 | DVCATCD == 99) & DVPLCLASCD == 1) | DVCATCD == 3)
tmp2 <- EX %>% filter((EXIVYNCD == 0 & EXIV50YNCD == 0) | (EXORYNCD == 0 & EXOR50YNCD == 0))
PP_set <- FA_set %>% 
  anti_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  anti_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId")
dim(PP_set)
PP_set
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

write_xlsx(x = tmp, path = file.path(getwd(), "Output Files", "PP Set - Included Subjects.xlsx"), col_names = TRUE, format_headers = TRUE)

```

The *PP set* (*n* = `r dim(PP_set)[1]`) includes all randomized subjects with a signed informed consent for whom the protocol has been followed (i.e., eligibility criteria fulfilled, allocated treatment identical to received treatment, and no major protocol deviations), classified according to the allocated (and received) treatment. The ITT, FA, and PP sets all include subjects who later revoke their informed consent.

# Data Imputation

We do some data imputation.

## Adjustment Covariates

We impute missing values of the adjustment covariates age and BMI. There are no missing values of main indication for induction or study site.

### Age

We check the proportion of missing values of age in the ITT set, the FA set, and the PP set, respectively.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Checking the proportion of missing values of age
tmp1 <- ITT_set %>% left_join(y = DM, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp2 <- sum(is.na(tmp1$DMAGE), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp3 <- round(x = tmp2 / dim(tmp1)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
tmp4 <- FA_set %>% left_join(y = DM, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp5 <- sum(is.na(tmp4$DMAGE), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp6 <- round(x = tmp5 / dim(tmp4)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
tmp7 <- PP_set %>% left_join(y = DM, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp8 <- sum(is.na(tmp7$DMAGE), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp9 <- round(x = tmp8 / dim(tmp7)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
print(paste("Missing values of age in the ITT set: ", tmp2, " subjects (", tmp3, "%)", sep = ""))
print(paste("Missing values of age in the FA set: ", tmp5, " subjects (", tmp6, "%)", sep = ""))
print(paste("Missing values of age in the PP set: ", tmp8, " subjects (", tmp9, "%)", sep = ""))
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

We impute missing values of age, if any, using mean (single) imputation, performed separately for each allocated treatment group, based on the ITT set, FA set, and the PP set, respectively. Missing values of categorized age are implicitly imputed by categorizing age with imputed values.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Imputing missing values of age, if any, using mean (single) imputation, by allocated treatment group
tmp1 <- DM %>% 
  semi_join(y = ITT_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp1 = mean(DMAGE, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp2 <- DM %>% 
  semi_join(y = FA_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp2 = mean(DMAGE, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp3 <- DM %>% 
  semi_join(y = PP_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp3 = mean(DMAGE, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp4 <- DM %>% 
  full_join(y = ITT_set, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  mutate(
    DMAGE_mean_imputation_ITT_set = if_else(condition = is.na(DMAGE), true = tmp1, false = DMAGE, missing = NULL), 
    DMAGE_mean_imputation_ITT_set_cat = case_when(
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_ITT_set < 25                                       ~ 1, 
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_ITT_set >= 25 & DMAGE_mean_imputation_ITT_set < 30 ~ 2, 
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_ITT_set >= 30 & DMAGE_mean_imputation_ITT_set < 35 ~ 3, 
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_ITT_set >= 35 & DMAGE_mean_imputation_ITT_set < 40 ~ 4, 
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_ITT_set >= 40                                      ~ 5, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    DMAGE_mean_imputation_ITT_set_cat_factor = factor(x = DMAGE_mean_imputation_ITT_set_cat, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), labels = c("< 25 years", "25-29 years", "30-34 years", "35-39 years", ">= 40 years")), 
    DMAGE_mean_imputation_FA_set = if_else(condition = is.na(DMAGE), true = tmp2, false = DMAGE, missing = NULL), 
    DMAGE_mean_imputation_FA_set_cat = case_when(
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_FA_set < 25                                      ~ 1, 
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_FA_set >= 25 & DMAGE_mean_imputation_FA_set < 30 ~ 2, 
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_FA_set >= 30 & DMAGE_mean_imputation_FA_set < 35 ~ 3, 
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_FA_set >= 35 & DMAGE_mean_imputation_FA_set < 40 ~ 4, 
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_FA_set >= 40                                     ~ 5, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    DMAGE_mean_imputation_FA_set_cat_factor = factor(x = DMAGE_mean_imputation_FA_set_cat, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), labels = c("< 25 years", "25-29 years", "30-34 years", "35-39 years", ">= 40 years")), 
    DMAGE_mean_imputation_PP_set = if_else(condition = is.na(DMAGE), true = tmp3, false = DMAGE, missing = NULL), 
    DMAGE_mean_imputation_PP_set_cat = case_when(
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_PP_set < 25                                      ~ 1, 
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_PP_set >= 25 & DMAGE_mean_imputation_PP_set < 30 ~ 2, 
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_PP_set >= 30 & DMAGE_mean_imputation_PP_set < 35 ~ 3, 
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_PP_set >= 35 & DMAGE_mean_imputation_PP_set < 40 ~ 4, 
      DMAGE_mean_imputation_PP_set >= 40                                     ~ 5, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    DMAGE_mean_imputation_PP_set_cat_factor = factor(x = DMAGE_mean_imputation_PP_set_cat, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), labels = c("< 25 years", "25-29 years", "30-34 years", "35-39 years", ">= 40 years")), 
    .after = DMAGE_cat_factor
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(tmp1, tmp2, tmp3))
tmp4 %>% anti_join(y = DM, by = "SubjectId") %>% select(SubjectId) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% sort()
DM <- tmp4
dim(DM)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

### BMI

We check the proportion of missing values of BMI in the ITT set, the FA set, and the PP set, respectively.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Checking the proportion of missing values of BMI
tmp1 <- ITT_set %>% left_join(y = PE, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))

We impute missing values of BMI, if any, using mean (single) imputation, performed separately for each allocated treatment group, based on the ITT set, FA set, and the PP set, respectively. Missing values of categorized BMI are implicitly imputed by categorizing BMI with imputed values.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Imputing missing values of BMI, if any, using mean (single) imputation, by allocated treatment group
tmp1 <- PE %>% 
  semi_join(y = ITT_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp1 = mean(PEBMI, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp2 <- PE %>% 
  semi_join(y = FA_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp2 = mean(PEBMI, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp3 <- PE %>% 
  semi_join(y = PP_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp3 = mean(PEBMI, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp4 <- PE %>% 
  full_join(y = ITT_set, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  mutate(
    PEBMI_mean_imputation_ITT_set = if_else(condition = is.na(PEBMI), true = tmp1, false = PEBMI, missing = NA), 
    PEBMI_mean_imputation_ITT_set_cat = case_when(
      PEBMI_mean_imputation_ITT_set < 18.5                                       ~ 1, 
      PEBMI_mean_imputation_ITT_set >= 18.5 & PEBMI_mean_imputation_ITT_set < 25 ~ 2, 
      PEBMI_mean_imputation_ITT_set >= 25 & PEBMI_mean_imputation_ITT_set < 30   ~ 3, 
      PEBMI_mean_imputation_ITT_set >= 30                                        ~ 4, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    PEBMI_mean_imputation_ITT_set_cat_factor = factor(x = PEBMI_mean_imputation_ITT_set_cat, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("< 18.5 kg/m2", "18.5-24.9 kg/m2", "25.0-29.9 kg/m2", ">= 30.0 kg/m2")), 
    PEBMI_mean_imputation_FA_set = if_else(condition = is.na(PEBMI), true = tmp2, false = PEBMI, missing = NA), 
    PEBMI_mean_imputation_FA_set_cat = case_when(
      PEBMI_mean_imputation_FA_set < 18.5                                      ~ 1, 
      PEBMI_mean_imputation_FA_set >= 18.5 & PEBMI_mean_imputation_FA_set < 25 ~ 2, 
      PEBMI_mean_imputation_FA_set >= 25 & PEBMI_mean_imputation_FA_set < 30   ~ 3, 
      PEBMI_mean_imputation_FA_set >= 30                                       ~ 4, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    PEBMI_mean_imputation_FA_set_cat_factor = factor(x = PEBMI_mean_imputation_FA_set_cat, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("< 18.5 kg/m2", "18.5-24.9 kg/m2", "25.0-29.9 kg/m2", ">= 30.0 kg/m2")), 
    PEBMI_mean_imputation_PP_set = if_else(condition = is.na(PEBMI), true = tmp3, false = PEBMI, missing = NA), 
    PEBMI_mean_imputation_PP_set_cat = case_when(
      PEBMI_mean_imputation_PP_set < 18.5                                      ~ 1, 
      PEBMI_mean_imputation_PP_set >= 18.5 & PEBMI_mean_imputation_PP_set < 25 ~ 2, 
      PEBMI_mean_imputation_PP_set >= 25 & PEBMI_mean_imputation_PP_set < 30   ~ 3, 
      PEBMI_mean_imputation_PP_set >= 30                                       ~ 4, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    PEBMI_mean_imputation_PP_set_cat_factor = factor(x = PEBMI_mean_imputation_PP_set_cat, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("< 18.5 kg/m2", "18.5-24.9 kg/m2", "25.0-29.9 kg/m2", ">= 30.0 kg/m2")), 
    .after = PEBMI_cat_factor
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(tmp1, tmp2, tmp3))
tmp4 %>% anti_join(y = PE, by = "SubjectId") %>% select(SubjectId) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% sort()
PE <- tmp4
dim(PE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))

## Endpoints

We impute missing values of the endpoints.

### Spontaneous Vaginal Delivery

We check the proportion of missing values of spontaneous vaginal delivery in the ITT set, the FA set, and the PP set, respectively.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Checking the proportion of missing values of spontaneous vaginal delivery
tmp1 <- ITT_set %>% left_join(y = DE, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp2 <- sum(is.na(tmp1$spontaneous_vaginal_delivery), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp3 <- round(x = tmp2 / dim(tmp1)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
tmp4 <- FA_set %>% left_join(y = DE, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp5 <- sum(is.na(tmp4$spontaneous_vaginal_delivery), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp6 <- round(x = tmp5 / dim(tmp4)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
tmp7 <- PP_set %>% left_join(y = DE, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp8 <- sum(is.na(tmp7$spontaneous_vaginal_delivery), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp9 <- round(x = tmp8 / dim(tmp7)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
print(paste("Missing values of spontaneous vaginal delivery in the ITT set: ", tmp2, " subjects (", tmp3, "%)", sep = ""))
print(paste("Missing values of spontaneous vaginal delivery in the FA set: ", tmp5, " subjects (", tmp6, "%)", sep = ""))
print(paste("Missing values of spontaneous vaginal delivery in the PP set: ", tmp8, " subjects (", tmp9, "%)", sep = ""))
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

We impute missing values of spontaneous vaginal delivery, if any, using best-case and worst-case imputation.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}

# Imputing missing values of the type of event for time from the onset of active labor to delivery, if any, using event-of-interest (single) imputation
# NOTE: A value of 1 corresponds to the event of interest, and a value of 2 corresponds to the competing event.

    .after = time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_event_factor
  )

We impute missing values of time from the onset of active labor to delivery, if any, using mean (single) imputation, performed separately for the event of interest and the competing event and for each allocated treatment group, based on the ITT set, FA set, and the PP set, respectively.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Imputing missing values of time from the onset of active labor to delivery, if any, using mean (single) imputation, by type of event and allocated treatment group
# NOTE: The code below also imputes non-positive values, which corresponds to the onset of active labor after or at the same time as delivery. Is this correct?
tmp1 <- DE %>% 
  semi_join(y = ITT_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  filter(time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery > 0) %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_event_event_of_interest) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp1 = mean(time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp2 <- DE %>% 
  semi_join(y = FA_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  filter(time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery > 0) %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_event_event_of_interest) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp2 = mean(time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp3 <- DE %>% 
  semi_join(y = PP_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  filter(time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery > 0) %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_event_event_of_interest) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp3 = mean(time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp4 <- DE %>% 
  full_join(y = ITT_set, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num", "time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_event_event_of_interest")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num", "time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_event_event_of_interest")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num", "time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_event_event_of_interest")) %>% 
  mutate(
    time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_mean_imputation_ITT_set = if_else(condition = is.na(time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery) | time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery <= 0, true = tmp1, false = time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery, missing = NA), 
    time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_mean_imputation_FA_set = if_else(condition = is.na(time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery) | time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery <= 0, true = tmp2, false = time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery, missing = NA), 
    time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery_mean_imputation_PP_set = if_else(condition = is.na(time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery) | time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery <= 0, true = tmp3, false = time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery, missing = NA), 
    .after = time_from_onset_active_labor_to_delivery
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(tmp1, tmp2, tmp3))
tmp4 %>% anti_join(y = DE, by = "SubjectId") %>% select(SubjectId) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% sort()
DE <- tmp4
dim(DE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

# Imputing missing values of time from the 1st IMP administration to delivery, if any, using mean (single) imputation, by type of event and allocated treatment group
# NOTE: The code below also imputes non-positive values, which corresponds to the 1st IMP administration after or at the same time as delivery. Is this correct?
tmp1 <- DE %>% 
  semi_join(y = ITT_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  filter(time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery > 0) %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_event_event_of_interest) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp1 = mean(time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp2 <- DE %>% 
  semi_join(y = FA_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  filter(time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery > 0) %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_event_event_of_interest) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp2 = mean(time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp3 <- DE %>% 
  semi_join(y = PP_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  filter(time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery > 0) %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_event_event_of_interest) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp3 = mean(time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp4 <- DE %>% 
  full_join(y = ITT_set, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num", "time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_event_event_of_interest")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num", "time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_event_event_of_interest")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num", "time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_event_event_of_interest")) %>% 
  mutate(
    time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_mean_imputation_ITT_set = if_else(condition = is.na(time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery) | time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery <= 0, true = tmp1, false = time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery, missing = NA), 
    time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_mean_imputation_FA_set = if_else(condition = is.na(time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery) | time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery <= 0, true = tmp2, false = time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery, missing = NA), 
    time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery_mean_imputation_PP_set = if_else(condition = is.na(time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery) | time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery <= 0, true = tmp3, false = time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery, missing = NA), 
    .after = time_from_1st_IMP_administration_to_delivery
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(tmp1, tmp2, tmp3))
tmp4 %>% anti_join(y = DE, by = "SubjectId") %>% select(SubjectId) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% sort()
DE <- tmp4
dim(DE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>%

tmp5 <- VS %>%

  )

# Imputing missing values of maternal heart rate at and 30 minutes after the 1st IMP administration, if any, using multiple imputation
tmp1 <- VS %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1") %>% select(SubjectId, VSPULSE) %>% rename(VSPULSE_IMP1 = VSPULSE)
tmp2 <- VS %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1_30") %>% select(SubjectId, VSPULSE) %>% rename(VSPULSE_IMP1_30 = VSPULSE)
tmp3 <- DM %>% select(SubjectId, DMAGE, DMAGE_cat_factor)
tmp4 <- PE %>% select(SubjectId, PEBMI, PEBMI_cat_factor)

  left_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>%

  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Site_ = factor(x = SiteName), 
    Treatment_ = relevel(x = factor(x = Treatment_allocated_str), ref = "Peroral placebo & intravenous placebo"), 
    Main_indication_for_induction_ = relevel(x = factor(x = ININD), ref = "Postdates (as defined locally; latest 42+0 weeks)")
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(SubjectId, SiteName, SiteCode, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, ININD))
tmp7 <- FA_set %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp4, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp5, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  rename(
    Age = DMAGE, 
    Age_categorized_ = DMAGE_cat_factor, 
    BMI = PEBMI, 
    BMI_categorized_ = PEBMI_cat_factor
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Site_ = factor(x = SiteName), 
    Treatment_ = relevel(x = factor(x = Treatment_allocated_str), ref = "Peroral placebo & intravenous placebo"), 
    Main_indication_for_induction_ = relevel(x = factor(x = ININD), ref = "Postdates (as defined locally; latest 42+0 weeks)")
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(SubjectId, SiteName, SiteCode, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, ININD))
tmp8 <- PP_set %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp4, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp5, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  rename(
    Age = DMAGE, 
    Age_categorized_ = DMAGE_cat_factor, 
    BMI = PEBMI, 
    BMI_categorized_ = PEBMI_cat_factor
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Site_ = factor(x = SiteName), 
    Treatment_ = relevel(x = factor(x = Treatment_allocated_str), ref = "Peroral placebo & intravenous placebo"),

  ) %>% 
  select(-c(SubjectId, SiteName, SiteCode, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, ININD))
VSPULSE_multiple_imputation_ITT_set <- mice(
  data = tmp6,

)
VSPULSE_multiple_imputation_FA_set <- mice(

)

We impute missing values of change in maternal heart rate 30 minutes after the 1st IMP administration, if any, implicitly by subtracting maternal heart rate at the 1st IMP administration with imputed values from maternal heart rate 30 minutes after the 1st IMP administration with imputed values.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Imputing missing values of change in maternal heart rate 30 minutes after the 1st IMP administration, if any, implicitly by subtracting maternal heart rate at the 1st IMP administration with imputed values from maternal heart rate 30 minutes after the 1st IMP administration with imputed values
tmp1 <- ITT_set %>% 
  bind_rows(ITT_set, .id = "identifier") %>% 
  mutate(EventId = "V01", ActivityId = if_else(condition = identifier == 1, true = "IMP1", false = "IMP1_30", missing = NA)) %>% 
  select(-identifier)
tmp2 <- VS %>% 
  full_join(y = tmp1, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num", "EventId", "ActivityId")) %>% 
  arrange(SubjectId, EventId, ActivityId) %>% 
  group_by(SubjectId, EventId) %>% 
  mutate(
    VSPULSE_change_IMP1_30_mean_imputation_ITT_set = VSPULSE_mean_imputation_ITT_set - lag(x = VSPULSE_mean_imputation_ITT_set, n = 1, default = NULL), 
    VSPULSE_change_IMP1_30_mean_imputation_FA_set = VSPULSE_mean_imputation_FA_set - lag(x = VSPULSE_mean_imputation_FA_set, n = 1, default = NULL), 
    VSPULSE_change_IMP1_30_mean_imputation_PP_set = VSPULSE_mean_imputation_PP_set - lag(x = VSPULSE_mean_imputation_PP_set, n = 1, default = NULL)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1_30") %>% 
  select(SubjectId, EventId, ActivityId, VSPULSE_change_IMP1_30_mean_imputation_ITT_set, VSPULSE_change_IMP1_30_mean_imputation_FA_set, VSPULSE_change_IMP1_30_mean_imputation_PP_set)

tmp3 %>% anti_join(y = VS, by = c("SubjectId", "EventId", "ActivityId")) %>% select(SubjectId) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% sort()
VS <- tmp3
dim(VS)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))

### Pain Score

We check the proportion of missing values of pain score at the 1st IMP administration in the ITT set, the FA set, and the PP set, respectively.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Checking the proportion of missing values of pain score at the 1st IMP administration
tmp1 <- ITT_set %>% left_join(y = VS %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1"), by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp2 <- sum(is.na(tmp1$VSVAS), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp3 <- round(x = tmp2 / dim(tmp1)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
tmp4 <- FA_set %>% left_join(y = VS %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1"), by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp5 <- sum(is.na(tmp4$VSVAS), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp6 <- round(x = tmp5 / dim(tmp4)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
tmp7 <- PP_set %>% left_join(y = VS %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1"), by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp8 <- sum(is.na(tmp7$VSVAS), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp9 <- round(x = tmp8 / dim(tmp7)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
print(paste("Missing values of pain score at the 1st IMP administration in the ITT set: ", tmp2, " subjects (", tmp3, "%)", sep = ""))
print(paste("Missing values of pain score at the 1st IMP administration in the FA set: ", tmp5, " subjects (", tmp6, "%)", sep = ""))
print(paste("Missing values of pain score at the 1st IMP administration in the PP set: ", tmp8, " subjects (", tmp9, "%)", sep = ""))
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))

We impute missing values of pain score at and 30 minutes after the 1st IMP administration, if any, using mean (single) imputation, performed separately for each allocated treatment group, based on the ITT set, FA set, and the PP set, respectively.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Imputing missing values of pain score at and 30 minutes after the 1st IMP administration, if any, using mean (single) imputation, by allocated treatment group
tmp1 <- ITT_set %>% 
  bind_rows(ITT_set, .id = "identifier") %>% 
  mutate(EventId = "V01", ActivityId = if_else(condition = identifier == 1, true = "IMP1", false = "IMP1_30", missing = NA)) %>% 
  select(-identifier)
tmp2 <- VS %>% 
  filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1") %>% 
  semi_join(y = ITT_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp1 = mean(VSVAS, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp3 <- VS %>% 
  filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1_30") %>% 
  semi_join(y = ITT_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp2 = mean(VSVAS, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp4 <- VS %>% 
  filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1") %>% 
  semi_join(y = FA_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp3 = mean(VSVAS, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp5 <- VS %>% 
  filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1_30") %>% 
  semi_join(y = FA_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp4 = mean(VSVAS, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp6 <- VS %>% 
  filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1") %>% 
  semi_join(y = PP_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp5 = mean(VSVAS, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp7 <- VS %>% 
  filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1_30") %>% 
  semi_join(y = PP_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp6 = mean(VSVAS, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp8 <- VS %>% 
  full_join(y = tmp1, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num", "EventId", "ActivityId")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp4, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp5, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp6, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp7, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  mutate(
    VSVAS_mean_imputation_ITT_set = case_when(
      is.na(VSVAS) & EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1"    ~ tmp1, 
      is.na(VSVAS) & EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1_30" ~ tmp2, 
      .default = VSVAS
    ), 
    VSVAS_mean_imputation_FA_set = case_when(
      is.na(VSVAS) & EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1"    ~ tmp3, 
      is.na(VSVAS) & EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1_30" ~ tmp4, 
      .default = VSVAS
    ), 
    VSVAS_mean_imputation_PP_set = case_when(
      is.na(VSVAS) & EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1"    ~ tmp5, 
      is.na(VSVAS) & EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1_30" ~ tmp6, 
      .default = VSVAS
    ), 
    .after = VSVAS
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(tmp1, tmp2, tmp3, tmp4, tmp5, tmp6))
tmp8 %>% anti_join(y = VS, by = c("SubjectId", "EventId", "ActivityId")) %>% select(SubjectId) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% sort()
VS <- tmp8
dim(VS)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

We also impute missing values of pain score at and 30 minutes after the 1st IMP administration, if any, using multiple imputation.

```{r, include = FALSE}
# Imputing missing values of pain score at and 30 minutes after the 1st IMP administration, if any, using multiple imputation
tmp1 <- VS %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1") %>% select(SubjectId, VSVAS) %>% rename(VSVAS_IMP1 = VSVAS)
tmp2 <- VS %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1_30") %>% select(SubjectId, VSVAS) %>% rename(VSVAS_IMP1_30 = VSVAS)
tmp3 <- DM %>% select(SubjectId, DMAGE, DMAGE_cat_factor)
tmp4 <- PE %>% select(SubjectId, PEBMI, PEBMI_cat_factor)
tmp5 <- IN %>% select(SubjectId, ININD)
tmp6 <- ITT_set %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp4, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp5, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  rename(
    Age = DMAGE, 
    Age_categorized_ = DMAGE_cat_factor, 
    BMI = PEBMI, 
    BMI_categorized_ = PEBMI_cat_factor
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Site_ = factor(x = SiteName), 
    Treatment_ = relevel(x = factor(x = Treatment_allocated_str), ref = "Peroral placebo & intravenous placebo"), 
    Main_indication_for_induction_ = relevel(x = factor(x = ININD), ref = "Postdates (as defined locally; latest 42+0 weeks)")
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(SubjectId, SiteName, SiteCode, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, ININD))
tmp7 <- FA_set %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp4, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp5, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  rename(
    Age = DMAGE, 
    Age_categorized_ = DMAGE_cat_factor, 
    BMI = PEBMI, 
    BMI_categorized_ = PEBMI_cat_factor
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Site_ = factor(x = SiteName), 
    Treatment_ = relevel(x = factor(x = Treatment_allocated_str), ref = "Peroral placebo & intravenous placebo"), 
    Main_indication_for_induction_ = relevel(x = factor(x = ININD), ref = "Postdates (as defined locally; latest 42+0 weeks)")
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(SubjectId, SiteName, SiteCode, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, ININD))
tmp8 <- PP_set %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp4, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp5, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  rename(
    Age = DMAGE, 
    Age_categorized_ = DMAGE_cat_factor, 
    BMI = PEBMI, 
    BMI_categorized_ = PEBMI_cat_factor
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Site_ = factor(x = SiteName), 
    Treatment_ = relevel(x = factor(x = Treatment_allocated_str), ref = "Peroral placebo & intravenous placebo"), 
    Main_indication_for_induction_ = relevel(x = factor(x = ININD), ref = "Postdates (as defined locally; latest 42+0 weeks)")
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(SubjectId, SiteName, SiteCode, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, ININD))
VSVAS_multiple_imputation_ITT_set <- mice(
  data = tmp6, 
  m = 20, 
  method = "pmm", 
  seed = 4
)
VSVAS_multiple_imputation_FA_set <- mice(
  data = tmp7, 
  m = 20, 
  method = "pmm", 
  seed = 5
)
VSVAS_multiple_imputation_PP_set <- mice(
  data = tmp8, 
  m = 20, 
  method = "pmm", 
  seed = 6
)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))

# Extracting the completed data, including the original data with missing values
VSVAS_multiple_imputation_ITT_set_complete <- complete(
  data = VSVAS_multiple_imputation_ITT_set, 
  action = "long", 
  include = TRUE, 
  order = "first"
)
VSVAS_multiple_imputation_FA_set_complete <- complete(
  data = VSVAS_multiple_imputation_FA_set, 
  action = "long", 
  include = TRUE, 
  order = "first"
)
VSVAS_multiple_imputation_PP_set_complete <- complete(
  data = VSVAS_multiple_imputation_PP_set, 
  action = "long", 
  include = TRUE, 
  order = "first"
)

We impute missing values of umbilical vein pH, if any, using mean (single) imputation, performed separately for each allocated treatment group, based on the ITT set, FA set, and the PP set, respectively.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Imputing missing values of umbilical vein pH, if any, using mean (single) imputation, by allocated treatment group
tmp1 <- NS %>% 
  semi_join(y = ITT_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp1 = mean(NSPHVENE, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp2 <- NS %>% 
  semi_join(y = FA_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp2 = mean(NSPHVENE, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp3 <- NS %>% 
  semi_join(y = PP_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp3 = mean(NSPHVENE, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp4 <- NS %>% 
  full_join(y = ITT_set, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  mutate(
    NSPHVENE_mean_imputation_ITT_set = if_else(condition = is.na(NSPHVENE), true = tmp1, false = NSPHVENE, missing = NA), 
    NSPHVENE_mean_imputation_FA_set = if_else(condition = is.na(NSPHVENE), true = tmp2, false = NSPHVENE, missing = NA), 
    NSPHVENE_mean_imputation_PP_set = if_else(condition = is.na(NSPHVENE), true = tmp3, false = NSPHVENE, missing = NA), 
    .after = NSPHVENE
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(tmp1, tmp2, tmp3))
tmp4 %>% anti_join(y = NS, by = "SubjectId") %>% select(SubjectId) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% sort()
NS <- tmp4
dim(NS)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

We also impute missing values of umbilical vein pH, if any, using multiple imputation.

```{r, include = FALSE}
# Imputing missing values of umbilical vein pH, if any, using multiple imputation
tmp1 <- NS %>% select(SubjectId, NSPHVENE)
tmp2 <- DM %>% select(SubjectId, DMAGE, DMAGE_cat_factor)
tmp3 <- PE %>% select(SubjectId, PEBMI, PEBMI_cat_factor)
tmp4 <- IN %>% select(SubjectId, ININD)
tmp5 <- ITT_set %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp4, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  rename(
    Age = DMAGE, 
    Age_categorized_ = DMAGE_cat_factor, 
    BMI = PEBMI, 
    BMI_categorized_ = PEBMI_cat_factor
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Site_ = factor(x = SiteName), 
    Treatment_ = relevel(x = factor(x = Treatment_allocated_str), ref = "Peroral placebo & intravenous placebo"), 
    Main_indication_for_induction_ = relevel(x = factor(x = ININD), ref = "Postdates (as defined locally; latest 42+0 weeks)")
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(SubjectId, SiteName, SiteCode, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, ININD))
tmp6 <- FA_set %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp4, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  rename(
    Age = DMAGE, 
    Age_categorized_ = DMAGE_cat_factor, 
    BMI = PEBMI, 
    BMI_categorized_ = PEBMI_cat_factor
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Site_ = factor(x = SiteName), 
    Treatment_ = relevel(x = factor(x = Treatment_allocated_str), ref = "Peroral placebo & intravenous placebo"), 
    Main_indication_for_induction_ = relevel(x = factor(x = ININD), ref = "Postdates (as defined locally; latest 42+0 weeks)")
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(SubjectId, SiteName, SiteCode, Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num, ININD))
tmp7 <- PP_set %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp4, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  rename(
    Age = DMAGE,

We impute missing values of umbilical vein pH < 7.10, if any, implicitly by dichotomizing umbilical vein pH with imputed values.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Imputing missing values of umbilical vein pH < 7.10, if any, implicitly by dichotomizing umbilical vein pH with imputed values

      .default = NULL
    ), 
    NSPHVENE_dich1_mean_imputation_ITT_set_factor = factor(x = NSPHVENE_dich1_mean_imputation_ITT_set, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    NSPHVENE_dich1_mean_imputation_FA_set = case_when(
      NSPHVENE_mean_imputation_FA_set >= 7.1 ~ 0, 
      NSPHVENE_mean_imputation_FA_set < 7.1  ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    NSPHVENE_dich1_mean_imputation_FA_set_factor = factor(x = NSPHVENE_dich1_mean_imputation_FA_set, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    NSPHVENE_dich1_mean_imputation_PP_set = case_when(
      NSPHVENE_mean_imputation_PP_set >= 7.1 ~ 0, 
      NSPHVENE_mean_imputation_PP_set < 7.1  ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    NSPHVENE_dich1_mean_imputation_PP_set_factor = factor(x = NSPHVENE_dich1_mean_imputation_PP_set, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    .after = NSPHVENE_dich1_factor
  )
tmp %>% anti_join(y = NS, by = "SubjectId") %>% select(SubjectId) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% sort()
NS <- tmp
dim(NS)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))

### Umbilical Artery pH

We check the proportion of missing values of umbilical artery pH in the ITT set, the FA set, and the PP set, respectively.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Checking the proportion of missing values of umbilical artery pH
tmp1 <- ITT_set %>% left_join(y = NS, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp2 <- sum(is.na(tmp1$NSPHART), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp3 <- round(x = tmp2 / dim(tmp1)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
tmp4 <- FA_set %>% left_join(y = NS, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp5 <- sum(is.na(tmp4$NSPHART), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp6 <- round(x = tmp5 / dim(tmp4)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
tmp7 <- PP_set %>% left_join(y = NS, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp8 <- sum(is.na(tmp7$NSPHART), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp9 <- round(x = tmp8 / dim(tmp7)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
print(paste("Missing values of umbilical artery pH in the ITT set: ", tmp2, " subjects (", tmp3, "%)", sep = ""))
print(paste("Missing values of umbilical artery pH in the FA set: ", tmp5, " subjects (", tmp6, "%)", sep = ""))
print(paste("Missing values of umbilical artery pH in the PP set: ", tmp8, " subjects (", tmp9, "%)", sep = ""))
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

We impute missing values of umbilical artery pH, if any, using mean (single) imputation, performed separately for each allocated treatment group, based on the ITT set, FA set, and the PP set, respectively.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Imputing missing values of umbilical artery pH, if any, using mean (single) imputation, by allocated treatment group
tmp1 <- NS %>% 
  semi_join(y = ITT_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp1 = mean(NSPHART, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp2 <- NS %>% 
  semi_join(y = FA_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp2 = mean(NSPHART, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp3 <- NS %>% 
  semi_join(y = PP_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp3 = mean(NSPHART, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp4 <- NS %>% 
  full_join(y = ITT_set, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  mutate(
    NSPHART_mean_imputation_ITT_set = if_else(condition = is.na(NSPHART), true = tmp1, false = NSPHART, missing = NA), 
    NSPHART_mean_imputation_FA_set = if_else(condition = is.na(NSPHART), true = tmp2, false = NSPHART, missing = NA), 
    NSPHART_mean_imputation_PP_set = if_else(condition = is.na(NSPHART), true = tmp3, false = NSPHART, missing = NA), 
    .after = NSPHART
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(tmp1, tmp2, tmp3))
tmp4 %>% anti_join(y = NS, by = "SubjectId") %>% select(SubjectId) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% sort()
NS <- tmp4
dim(NS)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Checking the proportion of missing values of 5-minute Apgar score
tmp1 <- ITT_set %>% left_join(y = NS, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp2 <- sum(is.na(tmp1$NSAPSC5), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp3 <- round(x = tmp2 / dim(tmp1)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
tmp4 <- FA_set %>% left_join(y = NS, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp5 <- sum(is.na(tmp4$NSAPSC5), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp6 <- round(x = tmp5 / dim(tmp4)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
tmp7 <- PP_set %>% left_join(y = NS, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp8 <- sum(is.na(tmp7$NSAPSC5), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp9 <- round(x = tmp8 / dim(tmp7)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
print(paste("Missing values of 5-minute Apgar score in the ITT set: ", tmp2, " subjects (", tmp3, "%)", sep = ""))
print(paste("Missing values of 5-minute Apgar score in the FA set: ", tmp5, " subjects (", tmp6, "%)", sep = ""))
print(paste("Missing values of 5-minute Apgar score in the PP set: ", tmp8, " subjects (", tmp9, "%)", sep = ""))
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

We impute missing values of 5-minute Apgar score, if any, using mode (single) imputation, performed separately for each allocated treatment group, based on the ITT set, FA set, and the PP set, respectively.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Imputing missing values of 5-minute Apgar score, if any, using mode (single) imputation, by allocated treatment group
tmp1 <- NS %>% 
  semi_join(y = ITT_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp1 = find_highest_mode1(NSAPSC5), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp2 <- NS %>% 
  semi_join(y = FA_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp2 = find_highest_mode1(NSAPSC5), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp3 <- NS %>% 
  semi_join(y = PP_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  group_by(Treatment_allocated_str, Treatment_allocated_num) %>% 
  summarize(
    tmp3 = find_highest_mode1(NSAPSC5), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp4 <- NS %>% 
  full_join(y = ITT_set, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp3, by = c("Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  mutate(
    NSAPSC5_mode_imputation_ITT_set = if_else(condition = is.na(NSAPSC5), true = tmp1, false = NSAPSC5, missing = NA), 
    NSAPSC5_mode_imputation_FA_set = if_else(condition = is.na(NSAPSC5), true = tmp2, false = NSAPSC5, missing = NA), 
    NSAPSC5_mode_imputation_PP_set = if_else(condition = is.na(NSAPSC5), true = tmp3, false = NSAPSC5, missing = NA), 
    .after = NSAPSC5
  ) %>% 
  select(-c(tmp1, tmp2, tmp3))
tmp4 %>% anti_join(y = NS, by = "SubjectId") %>% select(SubjectId) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% sort()
NS <- tmp4
dim(NS)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

tmp3 <- round(x = tmp2 / dim(tmp1)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
tmp4 <- FA_set %>% left_join(y = NS, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp5 <- sum(is.na(tmp4$NSAPSC10_dich), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp6 <- round(x = tmp5 / dim(tmp4)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
tmp7 <- PP_set %>% left_join(y = NS, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num"))
tmp8 <- sum(is.na(tmp7$NSAPSC10_dich), na.rm = TRUE)
tmp9 <- round(x = tmp8 / dim(tmp7)[1] * 100, digits = 1)
print(paste("Missing values of 10-minute Apgar score < 7 in the ITT set: ", tmp2, " subjects (", tmp3, "%)", sep = ""))
print(paste("Missing values of 10-minute Apgar score < 7 in the FA set: ", tmp5, " subjects (", tmp6, "%)", sep = ""))
print(paste("Missing values of 10-minute Apgar score < 7 in the PP set: ", tmp8, " subjects (", tmp9, "%)", sep = ""))
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

We impute missing values of 10-minute Apgar score < 7, if any, implicitly by dichotomizing 10-minute Apgar score with imputed values.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Imputing missing values of 10-minute Apgar score < 7, if any, implicitly by dichotomizing 10-minute Apgar score with imputed values
tmp <- NS %>% 
  full_join(y = ITT_set, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  mutate(
    NSAPSC10_dich_mode_imputation_ITT_set = case_when(
      NSAPSC10_mode_imputation_ITT_set >= 7 ~ 0, 
      NSAPSC10_mode_imputation_ITT_set < 7  ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    NSAPSC10_dich_mode_imputation_ITT_set_factor = factor(x = NSAPSC10_dich_mode_imputation_ITT_set, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    NSAPSC10_dich_mode_imputation_FA_set = case_when(
      NSAPSC10_mode_imputation_FA_set >= 7 ~ 0, 
      NSAPSC10_mode_imputation_FA_set < 7  ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    NSAPSC10_dich_mode_imputation_FA_set_factor = factor(x = NSAPSC10_dich_mode_imputation_FA_set, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    NSAPSC10_dich_mode_imputation_PP_set = case_when(
      NSAPSC10_mode_imputation_PP_set >= 7 ~ 0, 
      NSAPSC10_mode_imputation_PP_set < 7  ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    NSAPSC10_dich_mode_imputation_PP_set_factor = factor(x = NSAPSC10_dich_mode_imputation_PP_set, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    .after = NSAPSC10_dich_factor
  )
tmp %>% anti_join(y = NS, by = "SubjectId") %>% select(SubjectId) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% sort()
NS <- tmp
dim(NS)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

We also impute missing values of 10-minute Apgar score < 7, if any, using best-case and worst-case imputation.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Imputing missing values of 10-minute Apgar score < 7, if any, using best-case and worst-case imputation
tmp <- NS %>% 
  full_join(y = ITT_set, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteName", "SiteCode", "Treatment_allocated_str", "Treatment_allocated_num")) %>% 
  mutate(
    NSAPSC10_dich_best_case = if_else(condition = is.na(NSAPSC10), true = 0, false = NSAPSC10_dich, missing = NA), 
    NSAPSC10_dich_best_case_factor = factor(x = NSAPSC10_dich_best_case, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    NSAPSC10_dich_worst_case = if_else(condition = is.na(NSAPSC10), true = 1, false = NSAPSC10_dich, missing = NA), 
    NSAPSC10_dich_worst_case_factor = factor(x = NSAPSC10_dich_worst_case, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")), 
    .after = NSAPSC10_dich_mode_imputation_PP_set_factor
  )
tmp %>% anti_join(y = NS, by = "SubjectId") %>% select(SubjectId) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% sort()
NS <- tmp
dim(NS)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

# Summary Statistics and Plots

We produce summary statistics and plots of some relevant variables.

## Signed Informed Consent

*Figure 1* displays the cumulative sum of the number of subjects in the FA set with signed informed consent plotted against calendar date at each of the `r FA_set %>% select(SiteName) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% length()` study sites.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Figure 1: Cumulative sum of the number of subjects in the full-analysis set with signed informed consent as a function of calendar date, by study site."}
# Creating a plot of the cumulative sum of the number of subjects in the FA set with signed informed consent as a function of calendar date, by study site
tmp1 <- DM %>%

tmp2 <- "Data source: DM form"
plot_signed_informed_consent <- create_plot_cumsum_date(

)

```

## Randomization

*Figure X* displays the cumulative sum of the number of randomized subjects in the FA set overall plotted against calendar date.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Figure X: Cumulative sum of the number of randomized subjects in the full-analysis set as a function of calendar date, overall."}
# Creating a plot of the cumulative sum of the number of randomized subjects in the FA set as a function of calendar date, overall
tmp1 <- EX %>% 
  filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01") %>% 
  select(SubjectId, SiteCode , EXALDAT)
tmp2 <- EX %>% 
  filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1") %>% 
  select(SubjectId, SiteCode , EXDAT)
tmp3 <- tmp1 %>% 
  full_join(y = tmp2, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteCode")) %>% 
  semi_join(y = FA_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(date = min(EXALDAT, EXDAT, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    week1 = floor_date(x = date, unit = "week", week_start = 1), 
    week2 = floor_date(x = date, unit = "week", week_start = 1) - weeks(x = 1 - isoweek(x = date) %% 2), 
    month = floor_date(x = date, unit = "month", week_start = 1)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(month) %>% 
  summarize(
    number = n(), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp4 <- seq(from = min(tmp3$month), to = max(tmp3$month), by = "month")
tmp5 <- tibble(month = tmp4)
tmp6 <- tmp3 %>% 
  full_join(y = tmp5, by = "month") %>% 
  mutate(number = if_else(condition = is.na(number), true = 0, false = number, missing = NULL)) %>% 
  arrange(month) %>% 
  mutate(cumulative_number = cumsum(number)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(number, cumulative_number), names_to = "name", values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(
    name = factor(x = name, levels = c("number", "cumulative_number"), labels = c("Monthly count", "Cumulative count")), 
    value = if_else(condition = name == "Cumulative count", true = value / 20, false = value, missing = NULL)
  )
plot_randomization_overall <- ggplot(data = tmp6, mapping = aes(x = month, color = name)) + 
  geom_step(mapping = aes(y = value)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    sec.axis = sec_axis(transform = ~ . * 20, name = "Cumulative number of subjects")
  ) + 
  labs(
    x = "Calendar month", 
    y = "Monthly number of subjects", 
    title = "Subject randomization overall", 
    caption = NULL
  ) + 
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title = NULL, 
      direction = "vertical", 
      nrow = 1, 
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) + 
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12), 
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0, angle = -45), 
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
plot_randomization_overall
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))

# Saving the plot as a PDF file
ggsave(
  filename = "Randomization - Overall.pdf", 
  plot = last_plot(), 
  device = "pdf", 
  path = file.path(getwd(), "Output Files"), 
  width = 12, 
  height = 8, 
  units = "in", 
  dpi = 300
)

# Saving the plot as a PNG file
ggsave(
  filename = "Randomization - Overall.png", 
  plot = last_plot(), 
  device = "png", 
  path = file.path(getwd(), "Output Files"), 
  width = 12, 
  height = 8, 
  units = "in", 
  dpi = 300
)
```

*Figure X* displays the cumulative sum of the number of randomized subjects in the FA set at each of the `r FA_set %>% select(SiteName) %>% deframe() %>% unique() %>% length()` study sites plotted against calendar date.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE, fig.cap = "Figure X: Cumulative sum of the number of randomized subjects in the full-analysis set as a function of calendar date, by study site."}
# Creating a plot of the cumulative sum of the number of randomized subjects in the FA set as a function of calendar date, by study site
# NOTE: This is Figure S2 in the paper.
tmp1 <- EX %>% 
  filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01") %>% 
  select(SubjectId, SiteCode , EXALDAT)
tmp2 <- EX %>% 
  filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "IMP1") %>% 
  select(SubjectId, SiteCode , EXDAT)
tmp3 <- tmp1 %>% 
  full_join(y = tmp2, by = c("SubjectId", "SiteCode")) %>% 
  semi_join(y = FA_set, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  mutate(
    site = factor(
      x = SiteCode, 
      levels = c("01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "06", "07", "08", "09", "10", "11"), 
      labels = c("Oslo University Hospital - Rikshospitalet", paste("Oslo University Hospital - Ullev", "\U00E5", "l Hospital", sep = ""), "Akershus University Hospital", "Vestre Viken Hospital Trust - Drammen Hospital", paste("\U00D8", "stfold Hospital Trust", sep = ""), paste("S", "\U00F8", "rlandet Hospital Trust", sep = ""), "Stavanger University Hospital", "Haukeland University Hospital", "St. Olav University Hospital", "University Hospital of North Norway", paste("Vestre Viken Hospital Trust - B", "\U00E6", "rum Hospital", sep = ""))
    )
  ) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(date = min(EXALDAT, EXDAT, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    week1 = floor_date(x = date, unit = "week", week_start = 1), 
    week2 = floor_date(x = date, unit = "week", week_start = 1) - weeks(x = 1 - isoweek(x = date) %% 2), 
    month = floor_date(x = date, unit = "month", week_start = 1)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(site, month) %>% 
  summarize(
    number = n(), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )
tmp4 <- levels(tmp3$site)
tmp5 <- seq(from = min(tmp3$month), to = max(tmp3$month), by = "month")
tmp6 <- tibble(
  site = factor(x = rep(x = tmp4, each = length(tmp5)), levels = tmp4), 
  month = rep(x = tmp5, times = length(tmp4))
)
tmp7 <- tmp3 %>% 
  full_join(y = tmp6, by = c("site", "month")) %>% 
  mutate(number = if_else(condition = is.na(number), true = 0, false = number, missing = NULL)) %>% 
  arrange(site, month) %>% 
  group_by(site) %>% 
  mutate(cumulative_number = cumsum(number)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(number, cumulative_number), names_to = "name", values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(
    name = factor(x = name, levels = c("number", "cumulative_number"), labels = c("Monthly count", "Cumulative count")), 
    value = if_else(condition = name == "Cumulative count", true = value / 20, false = value, missing = NULL)
  )
plot_randomization_by_site <- ggplot(data = tmp7, mapping = aes(x = month, color = name)) + 
  geom_step(mapping = aes(y = value)) + 
  facet_wrap(
    facets = vars(site), 
    nrow = 3, 
    scales = "fixed", 
    dir = "h"
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    sec.axis = sec_axis(transform = ~ . * 20, name = "Cumulative number of subjects")
  ) + 
  labs(
    x = "Calendar month", 
    y = "Monthly number of subjects", 
    title = NULL, 
    caption = NULL
  ) + 
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title = NULL, 
      direction = "vertical", 
      nrow = 1, 
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) + 
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0, angle = -45), 
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"), 
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
plot_randomization_by_site
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))

# Saving the plot as a PDF file
ggsave(
  filename = "Randomization - By Site (Figure S2).pdf", 
  plot = last_plot(), 
  device = "pdf", 
  path = file.path(getwd(), "Output Files"), 
  width = 15, 
  height = 9, 
  units = "in", 
  dpi = 300
)

# Saving the plot as a PNG file

  filename = "Randomization - By Site (Figure S2).png", 
  plot = last_plot(), 
  device = "png", 
  path = file.path(getwd(), "Output Files"), 
  width = 15, 
  height = 9, 
  units = "in",

)

## Patient Disposition

*Table 1* displays the patient disposition of subjects in the ITT set (*n* = `r dim(ITT_set)[1]`) in absolute and relative frequencies, by treatment group.

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Defining the table format
table_patient_disposition_ITT_set_format <- tribble(
  ~ desc, ~ var, ~ fun, ~ par, 
  "Total number of IMP doses",                   "",          "calculate_no_summary_statistics",           list(), 
  "- 0",                                         "EXNRDOSE",  "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "0"), 
  "- 1",                                         "EXNRDOSE",  "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "1"), 
  "- 2",                                         "EXNRDOSE",  "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "2"), 
  "- 3",                                         "EXNRDOSE",  "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "3"), 
  "- Missing",                                   "EXNRDOSE",  "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = ""), 
  "Reason for completion/discontinuation",       "",          "calculate_no_summary_statistics",           list(), 
  "- Completed the study according to protocol", "EOSREASCD", "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "1"), 
  "- Completed the study without CEQ",           "EOSREASCD", "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "2"), 
  "- Adverse Event",                             "EOSREASCD", "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "3"), 
  "- Withdrawal of informed consent",            "EOSREASCD", "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "4"), 
  "- Death",                                     "EOSREASCD", "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "5"), 
  "- Investigator decision",                     "EOSREASCD", "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "6"), 
  "- Non-compliance with any part of the study", "EOSREASCD", "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "7"), 
  "- Study termination",                         "EOSREASCD", "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "8"), 
  "- Other",                                     "EOSREASCD", "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "99"), 
  "- Missing",                                   "EOSREASCD", "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "")
)

# Creating a table of summary statistics
tmp1 <- EX %>% filter(EventId == "V01" & ActivityId == "V01") %>% select(SubjectId, EXNRDOSE)
tmp2 <- EOS %>% select(SubjectId, EOSREASCD)
tmp3 <- ITT_set %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp1, by = "SubjectId") %>% 
  left_join(y = tmp2, by = "SubjectId")
table_patient_disposition_ITT_set <- create_table_summary_statistics(table = table_patient_disposition_ITT_set_format, data = tmp3, group = "Treatment_allocated_str")
write_xlsx(x = table_patient_disposition_ITT_set, path = file.path(getwd(), "Output Files", "Patient Disposition - ITT Set.xlsx"), col_names = TRUE, format_headers = TRUE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))

# Creating a table in HTML
tmp1 <- dim(table_patient_disposition_ITT_set)[2]
tmp2 <- 0
tmp3 <- (1:dim(table_patient_disposition_ITT_set)[1])[which(substr(x = table_patient_disposition_ITT_set$Characteristic, start = 1, stop = 1) != "-")]
knitr::kable(x = table_patient_disposition_ITT_set, format = "html", align = c("l", rep(x = "c", times = tmp1 - 1)), caption = paste("Table 1: Patient disposition in the intention-to-treat set (", dim(ITT_set)[1], " subjects), by treatment group. Abbreviations: CEQ -- Childbirth Experience Questionnaire; IMP -- investigational medicinal product", sep = "")) %>% kable_classic(full_width = TRUE, html_font = "Computer Modern") %>% row_spec(row = tmp2, bold = TRUE) %>% row_spec(row = tmp3, italic = TRUE)
rm(list = ls(pattern = "^tmp"))
```

tmp2 <- c(1:6, 8:14, 99)
tmp3 <- c(1:17, 99)
tmp4 <- list(tmp2, tmp3)
tmp5 <- 0
tmp6 <- list()
for (i in 1:2) {
  for (j in 1:(length(tmp4[[i]]) + 2)) {
    tmp5 <- tmp5 + 1
    if (j == 1) {
      tmp6[[tmp5]] <- MH %>% 
        group_by(SubjectId) %>% 
        summarize(
          tmp = if_else(
            condition = sum(MHCATCD == i, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 & sum(MHCATCD == i, na.rm = FALSE) == 0, 
            true = 0, 
            false = 1, 
            missing = NA
          ), 
          .groups = "drop"
        )
    } else if (j == length(tmp4[[i]]) + 2) {
      tmp6[[tmp5]] <- MH %>% 
        group_by(SubjectId) %>% 
        summarize(
          tmp = if_else(
            condition = sum(MHCATCD == i, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 & sum(MHCATCD == i, na.rm = FALSE) == 0, 
            true = 2, 
            false = if_else(
              condition = sum(MHCATCD == i & MH1CD == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 & sum(MHCATCD == i & MH1CD == 1, na.rm = FALSE) == 0, 
              true = 0, 
              false = 1, 
              missing = NA
            ), 
            missing = NA
          ), 
          .groups = "drop"
        )
    } else {
      tmp6[[tmp5]] <- MH %>% 
        rename(tmp = if_else(condition = i == 1, true = "MHPRECD", false = "MHPRCCD", missing = NA)) %>% 
        group_by(SubjectId) %>% 
        summarize(
          tmp = if_else(
            condition = sum(MHCATCD == i, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 & sum(MHCATCD == i, na.rm = FALSE) == 0, 
            true = 2, 
            false = if_else(
              condition = sum(MHCATCD == i & tmp == tmp4[[i]][j - 1], na.rm = TRUE) == 0 & sum(MHCATCD == i & tmp == tmp4[[i]][j - 1], na.rm = FALSE) == 0, 
              true = 0, 
              false = 1, 
              missing = NA
            ), 
            missing = NA
          ), 
          .groups = "drop"
        )
    }
    tmp6[[tmp5]] <- tmp6[[tmp5]] %>% 
      rename_with(.fn = ~ paste("tmp", tmp5, sep = ""), .cols = tmp)
  }
}

    full_join(y = tmp6[[i]], by = "SubjectId")
}

  mutate(included_MH = 1)

for (i in 1:(dim(tmp7)[2] - 2)) {
  tmp8 <- tmp8 %>% 
    rename(tmp = paste("tmp", i, sep = ""))
  if (i == 1 | i == length(tmp4[[1]]) + 2 + 1) {
    tmp8 <- tmp8 %>% 
      mutate(tmp = if_else(condition = included_MH == 1, true = tmp, false = NA, missing = 0))
  } else {
    tmp8 <- tmp8 %>% 
      mutate(tmp = if_else(condition = included_MH == 1, true = tmp, false = NA, missing = 2))
  }
  tmp8 <- tmp8 %>% 
    rename_with(.fn = ~ paste("tmp", i, sep = ""), .cols = tmp)
}

### Key Baseline Characteristics

*Table 6* displays summary statistics of key baseline (i.e., start of induction) characteristics of subjects in the FA set (*n* = `r dim(FA_set)[1]`), overall and by treatment group. Continuous variables are presented with mean, standard deviation, median, and interquartile range. Categorical variables are presented with absolute and relative frequencies (i.e., numbers and percentages).

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Creating a table of summary statistics

  ~ desc, ~ var, ~ fun, ~ par, 
  "Age, continuous (yrs)",                     "",          "calculate_no_summary_statistics",           list(),

  "- Median (IQR)",                            "DMAGE",     "calculate_summary_statistics_continuous2",  list(digits = 1), 
  "- Missing",                                 "DMAGE",     "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = ""), 
  "Age, categorical",                          "",          "calculate_no_summary_statistics",           list(), 
  "- < 25 yrs",                                "DMAGE_cat", "calculate_summary_statistics_categorical2", list(digits = 1, level = "1"),

## Preintervention Characteristics

*Table 7* displays summary statistics of preintervention (i.e., directly preceding or at administration of 1st IMP dose) characteristics of subjects in the FA set (*n* = `r dim(FA_set)[1]`), overall and by treatment group. Categorical variables are presented with absolute and relative frequencies (i.e., numbers and percentages).

    ),

      is.na(EXOR50YNCD) & EXNRDOSE == 0 ~ 2, 
      is.na(EXOR50YNCD) & tmp3 == 1     ~ 1, 
      .default = NULL
    ), 
    tmp5 = case_when(
      !is.na(EXORVOYNCD)                ~ EXORVOYNCD, 
      is.na(EXORVOYNCD) & EXNRDOSE == 0 ~ 2,

    )

## Labor and Delivery Characteristics

*Table 9* displays summary statistics of labor and delivery characteristics of subjects in the FA set (*n* = `r dim(FA_set)[1]`), overall and by treatment group. Continuous variables are presented with mean, standard deviation, median, and interquartile range. Categorical variables are presented with absolute and relative frequencies (i.e., numbers and percentages).
